    86	export function requiresFoldedSessionKeyAliasProof(sessionKey: string | undefined | null): boolean {
    87	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
    88	  if (!raw) {
    89	    return false;
    90	  }
    91	  const parts = raw.split(":");
    92	  let bodyStartIndex = 0;
    93	  let hasAgentWrapper = false;
    94	  while (
    95	    parts.length - bodyStartIndex >= 3 &&
    96	    normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(parts[bodyStartIndex]) === "agent"
    97	  ) {
    98	    hasAgentWrapper = true;
    99	    bodyStartIndex += 2;
   100	  }
   101	  if (hasAgentWrapper) {
   102	    while (bodyStartIndex < parts.length && !normalizeOptionalString(parts[bodyStartIndex])) {
   103	      bodyStartIndex += 1;
   104	    }
   105	  }
   106	  const descriptor = findCasePreservingPeerDescriptor(
   107	    parts[bodyStartIndex],
   108	    parts[bodyStartIndex + 1],
   109	  );
   110	  return descriptor?.span === "tail";
   111	}

   127	function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
   128	  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

   131	type PreservedSpan = { start: number; end: number; trim: boolean };
   132	
   133	const NORMALIZED_SESSION_KEY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 2048;
   134	const NORMALIZED_SESSION_KEY_CACHE_MAX_LENGTH = 4096;
   135	const normalizedSessionKeyCache = new Map<string, string>();
   136	
   137	function readNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw: string): string | undefined {
   138	  return raw.length <= NORMALIZED_SESSION_KEY_CACHE_MAX_LENGTH
   139	    ? normalizedSessionKeyCache.get(raw)
   140	    : undefined;
   141	}
   142	
   143	function writeNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw: string, normalized: string): void {
   144	  if (raw.length > NORMALIZED_SESSION_KEY_CACHE_MAX_LENGTH) {
   145	    return;
   146	  }
   147	  normalizedSessionKeyCache.set(raw, normalized);
   148	  while (normalizedSessionKeyCache.size > NORMALIZED_SESSION_KEY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES) {
   149	    const oldest = normalizedSessionKeyCache.keys().next().value;
   150	    if (oldest === undefined) {
   151	      return;
   152	    }
   153	    normalizedSessionKeyCache.delete(oldest);
   154	  }
   155	}

   157	function mayContainCasePreservingPeer(raw: string): boolean {
   158	  const folded = raw.toLowerCase();
   159	  return CASE_PRESERVING_PEERS.some((descriptor) => folded.includes(`${descriptor.channel}:`));
   160	}
   161	
   162	/**
   163	 * Collect [start,end) index ranges in `raw` whose case must be preserved, per the
   164	 * CASE_PRESERVING_PEERS registry. Spans may come from multiple descriptors; the
   165	 * caller lowercases everything OUTSIDE their union — collect-then-emit, never
   166	 * sequential transforms that could re-lowercase an already-preserved span.
   167	 */
   168	function collectCasePreservedSpans(raw: string): PreservedSpan[] {
   169	  const spans: PreservedSpan[] = [];
   170	  for (const descriptor of CASE_PRESERVING_PEERS) {
   171	    const channel = escapeRegExp(descriptor.channel);
   172	    for (const peerKind of descriptor.peerKinds) {
   173	      const kind = escapeRegExp(peerKind);
   174	      if (descriptor.span === "segment") {
   175	        // Unscoped: `<channel>:<peerKind>:<segment>` at start or after any colon.
   176	        const re = new RegExp(`(^|:)${channel}:${kind}:([^:]+)`, "gi");
   177	        for (const match of raw.matchAll(re)) {
   178	          const matched = match[0] ?? "";
   179	          const segment = match[2] ?? "";
   180	          const segStart = (match.index ?? 0) + matched.length - segment.length;
   181	          // Segment spans match the legacy `peerId.trim()` behavior exactly.
   182	          spans.push({ start: segStart, end: segStart + segment.length, trim: true });
   183	        }
   184	      } else {
   185	        const collectTailSpan = (tailStart: number): void => {
   186	          if (tailStart >= raw.length) {
   187	            return;
   188	          }
   189	          // Preserve Matrix room/event IDs, but keep structural thread marker
   190	          // casing canonical so `:Thread:` cannot fork a session key.
   191	          const tail = raw.slice(tailStart);
   192	          const threadMarker = ":thread:";
   193	          const markerIndex = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(tail).lastIndexOf(threadMarker);
   194	          if (markerIndex === -1) {
   195	            spans.push({ start: tailStart, end: raw.length, trim: false });
   196	            return;
   197	          }
   198	          spans.push({ start: tailStart, end: tailStart + markerIndex, trim: false });
   199	          const threadIdStart = tailStart + markerIndex + threadMarker.length;
   200	          if (threadIdStart < raw.length) {
   201	            spans.push({ start: threadIdStart, end: raw.length, trim: false });
   202	          }
   203	        };
   204	        // Preserve tails behind nested or malformed ownership wrappers without
   205	        // treating an inner channel-shaped identity as a runtime route.
   206	        const scopedRe = new RegExp(`^(?:agent:[^:]*:)+:*${channel}:${kind}:`, "i");
   207	        const scopedMatch = scopedRe.exec(raw);
   208	        if (scopedMatch) {
   209	          collectTailSpan(scopedMatch[0].length);
   210	          continue;
   211	        }
   212	        if (descriptor.unscoped) {
   213	          const unscopedRe = new RegExp(`^${channel}:${kind}:`, "i");
   214	          const unscopedMatch = unscopedRe.exec(raw);
   215	          if (unscopedMatch) {
   216	            collectTailSpan(unscopedMatch[0].length);
   217	          }
   218	        }
   219	      }
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	  return spans;
   223	}
   224	
   225	export function normalizeSessionKeyPreservingOpaquePeerIds(
   226	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   227	): string {
   228	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
   229	  if (!raw) {
   230	    return "";
   231	  }
   232	  const cached = readNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw);
   233	  if (cached !== undefined) {
   234	    return cached;
   235	  }
   236	  if (!mayContainCasePreservingPeer(raw)) {
   237	    const normalized = raw.toLowerCase();
   238	    writeNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw, normalized);
   239	    return normalized;
   240	  }
   241	  const spans = collectCasePreservedSpans(raw)
   242	    .filter((span) => span.end > span.start)
   243	    .toSorted((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
   244	
   245	  let normalized = "";
   246	  let cursor = 0;
   247	  for (const span of spans) {
   248	    if (span.start < cursor) {
   249	      // Overlapping/contained in an already-emitted preserved range; skip.
   250	      continue;
   251	    }
   252	    normalized += normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw.slice(cursor, span.start));
   253	    const preserved = raw.slice(span.start, span.end);
   254	    normalized += span.trim ? preserved.trim() : preserved;
   255	    cursor = span.end;
   256	  }
   257	  normalized += normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw.slice(cursor));
   258	  writeNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw, normalized);
   259	  return normalized;
   260	}

   262	/**
   263	 * Parse agent-scoped session keys in a canonical, case-insensitive way.
   264	 * Returned values are canonicalized for stable comparisons/routing while
   265	 * preserving provider-owned opaque peer IDs.
   266	 */
   267	export function parseAgentSessionKey(
   268	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   269	): ParsedAgentSessionKey | null {
   270	  const raw = normalizeSessionKeyPreservingOpaquePeerIds(sessionKey);
   271	  if (!raw) {
   272	    return null;
   273	  }
   274	  const parts = raw.split(":");
   275	  if (parts.length < 3 || !parts[1] || !parts[2]) {
   276	    return null;
   277	  }
   278	  if (parts[0] !== "agent") {
   279	    return null;
   280	  }
   281	  const agentId = normalizeOptionalString(parts[1]);
   282	  const rest = parts.slice(2).join(":");
   283	  if (!agentId || !rest) {
   284	    return null;
   285	  }
   286	  return { agentId, rest };
   287	}

   293	  }

   297	/**
   298	 * Splits the terminal per-run `:run:<id>` scope off an isolated cron session key
   299	 * (`agent:<id>:cron:<job>:run:<runId>`), yielding the cache-stable base key.
   300	 * The run scope is only ever appended to cron keys, so this is gated to that exact
   301	 * shape: any other key (including channel ids that embed a `:run:` segment) is returned
   302	 * unchanged with `runId` undefined, never truncating an unrelated session identity.
   303	 */
   304	export function parseCronRunScopeSuffix(
   305	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   306	): ParsedCronRunScopeSuffix {
   307	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
   308	  if (!raw) {
   309	    return { baseSessionKey: undefined, runId: undefined };
   310	  }
   311	  const parsed = parseAgentSessionKey(raw);
   312	  if (!parsed || !/^cron:[^:]+:run:[^:]+$/.test(parsed.rest)) {
   313	    return { baseSessionKey: raw, runId: undefined };
   314	  }
   315	  const runMarker = ":run:";
   316	  const markerIndex = raw.toLowerCase().lastIndexOf(runMarker);
   317	  return {
   318	    baseSessionKey: raw.slice(0, markerIndex),
   319	    runId: raw.slice(markerIndex + runMarker.length),
   320	  };
   321	}

   368	export function parseThreadSessionSuffix(
   369	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   370	): ParsedThreadSessionSuffix {
   371	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
   372	  if (!raw) {
   373	    return { baseSessionKey: undefined, threadId: undefined };
   374	  }
   375	
   376	  const lowerRaw = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw);
   377	  const threadMarker = ":thread:";
   378	  const threadIndex = lowerRaw.lastIndexOf(threadMarker);
   379	  const markerIndex = threadIndex;
   380	  const marker = threadMarker;
   381	
   382	  const baseSessionKey = markerIndex === -1 ? raw : raw.slice(0, markerIndex);
   383	  const threadIdRaw = markerIndex === -1 ? undefined : raw.slice(markerIndex + marker.length);
   384	  const threadId = normalizeOptionalString(threadIdRaw);
   385	
   386	  return { baseSessionKey, threadId };
   387	}

   389	const SESSION_DELIVERY_PEER_KINDS = new Set<ParsedSessionDeliveryRoute["peerKind"]>([
   390	  "channel",
   391	  "direct",
   392	  "dm",
   393	  "group",
   394	]);
   395	
   396	/** Parse only complete external delivery shapes; nested ownership stays opaque. */
   397	export function parseSessionDeliveryRoute(
   398	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   399	): ParsedSessionDeliveryRoute | null {
   400	  const parsedThread = parseThreadSessionSuffix(sessionKey);
   401	  const parsed = parseAgentSessionKey(parsedThread.baseSessionKey ?? sessionKey);
   402	  if (!parsed) {
   403	    return null;
   404	  }
   405	  const parts = parsed.rest.split(":");
   406	  if (parts[0] === "agent" || parts.length < 3) {
   407	    return null;
   408	  }
   409	  const channel = normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(parts[0]);
   410	  if (!channel) {
   411	    return null;
   412	  }
   413	
   414	  if (parts.length >= 4 && (parts[2] === "direct" || parts[2] === "dm")) {
   415	    const accountId = normalizeOptionalString(parts[1]);
   416	    const firstPeerIdSegment = normalizeOptionalString(parts[3]);
   417	    const peerId = normalizeOptionalString(parts.slice(3).join(":"));
   418	    if (!accountId || !firstPeerIdSegment || !peerId) {
   419	      return null;
   420	    }
   421	    return {
   422	      accountId,
   423	      channel,
   424	      peerId,
   425	      peerKind: parts[2],
   426	      threadId: parsedThread.threadId,
   427	    };
   428	  }
   429	
   430	  const peerKind = parts[1] as ParsedSessionDeliveryRoute["peerKind"] | undefined;
   431	  const firstPeerIdSegment = normalizeOptionalString(parts[2]);
   432	  const peerId = normalizeOptionalString(parts.slice(2).join(":"));
   433	  if (!peerKind || !SESSION_DELIVERY_PEER_KINDS.has(peerKind) || !firstPeerIdSegment || !peerId) {
   434	    return null;
   435	  }
   436	  return { channel, peerId, peerKind, threadId: parsedThread.threadId };
   437	}
   438	
   439	export function parseRawSessionConversationRef(
   440	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   441	): RawSessionConversationRef | null {
   442	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
   443	  if (!raw) {
   444	    return null;
   445	  }
   446	
   447	  const rawParts = raw.split(":");
   448	  // Only the outer ownership wrapper is authoritative for routing. Any inner
   449	  // agent-shaped identity is opaque plugin input and must not inherit policy.
   450	  const hasAgentWrapper = normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(rawParts[0]) === "agent";
   451	  if (hasAgentWrapper && (!normalizeOptionalString(rawParts[1]) || rawParts.length < 3)) {
   452	    return null;
   453	  }
   454	  const bodyStartIndex = hasAgentWrapper ? 2 : 0;
   455	  const parts = rawParts.slice(bodyStartIndex);
   456	  if (normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(parts[0]) === "agent") {
   457	    return null;
   458	  }
   459	  // Empty opaque tail segments are valid (for example compressed IPv6), but
   460	  // structural owner/channel/kind/first-id segments must be present.
   461	  if (parts.length < 3 || !normalizeOptionalString(parts[2])) {
   462	    return null;
   463	  }
   464	
   465	  const channel = normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(parts[0]);
   466	  const kind = normalizeOptionalLowercaseString(parts[1]);
   467	  if (!channel || (kind !== "group" && kind !== "channel")) {
   468	    return null;
   469	  }
   470	
   471	  const rawId = normalizeOptionalString(parts.slice(2).join(":"));
   472	  const prefix = normalizeOptionalString(rawParts.slice(0, bodyStartIndex + 2).join(":"));
   473	  if (!rawId || !prefix) {
   474	    return null;
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  return { channel, kind, rawId, prefix };
   478	}

    79	export function normalizeExplicitChatSendOrigin(
    80	  params: ChatSendExplicitOrigin,
    81	): { ok: true; value?: ChatSendExplicitOrigin } | { ok: false; error: string } {
    82	  const originatingChannel = normalizeOptionalText(params.originatingChannel);
    83	  const originatingTo = normalizeOptionalText(params.originatingTo);
    84	  const accountId = normalizeOptionalText(params.accountId);
    85	  const messageThreadId = normalizeOptionalText(params.messageThreadId);
    86	  const hasAnyExplicitOriginField = Boolean(
    87	    originatingChannel || originatingTo || accountId || messageThreadId,
    88	  );
    89	  if (!hasAnyExplicitOriginField) {
    90	    return { ok: true };
    91	  }
    92	  const normalizedChannel = normalizeMessageChannel(originatingChannel);
    93	  if (!normalizedChannel) {
    94	    return {
    95	      ok: false,
    96	      error: "originatingChannel is required when using originating route fields",
    97	    };
    98	  }
    99	  if (!originatingTo) {
   100	    return {
   101	      ok: false,
   102	      error: "originatingTo is required when using originating route fields",
   103	    };
   104	  }
   105	  return {
   106	    ok: true,
   107	    value: {
   108	      originatingChannel: normalizedChannel,
   109	      originatingTo,
   110	      ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),
   111	      ...(messageThreadId ? { messageThreadId } : {}),
   112	    },
   113	  };
   114	}

   116	export function validateChatSelectedAgent(params: {
   117	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
   118	  requestedSessionKey: string;
   119	  agentId?: string;
   120	}): { ok: true; agentId?: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
   121	  const agentId = params.agentId ? normalizeAgentId(params.agentId) : undefined;
   122	  if (!agentId) {
   123	    return { ok: true };
   124	  }
   125	  if (!listAgentIds(params.cfg).includes(agentId)) {
   126	    return { ok: false, error: `Unknown agent id "${params.agentId}"` };
   127	  }
   128	  const requestedSessionKey = params.requestedSessionKey.trim();
   129	  const parsed = parseAgentSessionKey(requestedSessionKey);
   130	  if (parsed && normalizeAgentId(parsed.agentId) !== agentId) {
   131	    return {
   132	      ok: false,
   133	      error: `agentId "${params.agentId}" does not match session key "${params.requestedSessionKey}"`,
   134	    };
   135	  }
   136	  if (requestedSessionKey.toLowerCase() === "global") {
   137	    return { ok: true, agentId };
   138	  }
   139	  if (resolveSessionStoreKey({ cfg: params.cfg, sessionKey: requestedSessionKey }) === "global") {
   140	    return { ok: true, agentId };
   141	  }
   142	  if (!parsed || normalizeAgentId(parsed.agentId) !== agentId) {
   143	    return {
   144	      ok: false,
   145	      error: `agentId "${params.agentId}" does not match session key "${params.requestedSessionKey}"`,
   146	    };
   147	  }
   148	  return { ok: true, agentId };
   149	}

   151	export function resolveRequestedChatAgentId(params: {
   152	  cfg?: OpenClawConfig;
   153	  requestedSessionKey: string;
   154	  agentId?: string;
   155	}): string | undefined {
   156	  const explicitAgentId = normalizeOptionalText(params.agentId);
   157	  if (explicitAgentId) {

   159	  }

   167	  ) {
   168	    return undefined;
   169	  }
   170	  return normalizeAgentId(parsed.agentId);

   190	export function resolveChatSendOriginatingRoute(params: {
   191	  client?: { mode?: string | null; id?: string | null } | null;
   192	  deliver?: boolean;
   193	  entry?: ChatSendDeliveryEntry;
   194	  explicitOrigin?: ChatSendExplicitOrigin;
   195	  hasConnectedClient?: boolean;
   196	  mainKey?: string;
   197	  sessionKey: string;
   198	}): ChatSendOriginatingRoute {
   199	  if (params.explicitOrigin?.originatingChannel && params.explicitOrigin.originatingTo) {
   200	    return {
   201	      originatingChannel: params.explicitOrigin.originatingChannel,
   202	      originatingTo: params.explicitOrigin.originatingTo,
   203	      ...(params.explicitOrigin.accountId ? { accountId: params.explicitOrigin.accountId } : {}),
   204	      ...(params.explicitOrigin.messageThreadId
   205	        ? { messageThreadId: params.explicitOrigin.messageThreadId }
   206	        : {}),
   207	      explicitDeliverRoute: params.deliver === true,
   208	    };
   209	  }
   210	  if (params.deliver !== true) {

   217	  );

   219	  const routeAccountIdCandidate =
   220	    sessionDeliveryContext?.accountId ??
   221	    params.entry?.lastAccountId ??
   222	    params.entry?.origin?.accountId ??
   223	    undefined;
   224	  const routeThreadIdCandidate =
   225	    sessionDeliveryContext?.threadId ??
   226	    params.entry?.lastThreadId ??
   227	    params.entry?.origin?.threadId;
   228	  if (params.sessionKey.length > CHAT_SEND_SESSION_KEY_MAX_LENGTH) {
   229	    return { originatingChannel: INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL, explicitDeliverRoute: false };
   230	  }
   231	
   232	  const parsedSessionKey = parseAgentSessionKey(params.sessionKey);
   233	  const sessionScopeParts = (parsedSessionKey?.rest ?? params.sessionKey)
   234	    .split(":", 3)
   235	    .filter(Boolean);
   236	  const sessionScopeHead = sessionScopeParts[0];
   237	  const sessionChannelHint = normalizeMessageChannel(sessionScopeHead);
   238	  const normalizedSessionScopeHead = (sessionScopeHead ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
   239	  const sessionPeerShapeCandidates = [sessionScopeParts[1], sessionScopeParts[2]]
   240	    .map((part) => (part ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())
   241	    .filter(Boolean);
   242	  const isChannelAgnosticSessionScope = CHANNEL_AGNOSTIC_SESSION_SCOPES.has(
   243	    normalizedSessionScopeHead,
   244	  );
   245	  const isChannelScopedSession = sessionPeerShapeCandidates.some((part) =>
   246	    CHANNEL_SCOPED_SESSION_SHAPES.has(part),
   247	  );
   248	  const hasLegacyChannelPeerShape =
   249	    !isChannelScopedSession &&
   250	    typeof sessionScopeParts[1] === "string" &&
   251	    sessionChannelHint === routeChannelCandidate;
   252	  const isFromWebchatClient = isWebchatClient(params.client);
   253	  const isFromGatewayCliClient = isGatewayCliClient(params.client);
   254	  const hasClientMetadata =
   255	    (typeof params.client?.mode === "string" && params.client.mode.trim().length > 0) ||
   256	    (typeof params.client?.id === "string" && params.client.id.trim().length > 0);
   257	  const configuredMainKey = (params.mainKey ?? "main").trim().toLowerCase();
   258	  const isConfiguredMainSessionScope =
   259	    normalizedSessionScopeHead.length > 0 && normalizedSessionScopeHead === configuredMainKey;
   260	  const canInheritConfiguredMainRoute =
   261	    isConfiguredMainSessionScope &&
   262	    params.hasConnectedClient &&
   263	    (isFromGatewayCliClient || !hasClientMetadata);
   264	
   265	  // Webchat never inherits external delivery. Main-session inheritance is CLI-only
   266	  // unless an old caller omitted client metadata entirely.
   267	  const canInheritDeliverableRoute = Boolean(
   268	    !isFromWebchatClient &&
   269	    sessionChannelHint &&
   270	    sessionChannelHint !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL &&
   271	    ((!isChannelAgnosticSessionScope && (isChannelScopedSession || hasLegacyChannelPeerShape)) ||
   272	      canInheritConfiguredMainRoute),
   273	  );
   274	  const hasDeliverableRoute =
   275	    canInheritDeliverableRoute &&
   276	    routeChannelCandidate &&
   277	    routeChannelCandidate !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL &&
   278	    typeof routeToCandidate === "string" &&
   279	    routeToCandidate.trim().length > 0;
   280	
   281	  if (!hasDeliverableRoute) {
   282	    return { originatingChannel: INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL, explicitDeliverRoute: false };
   283	  }
   284	
   285	  return {
   286	    originatingChannel: routeChannelCandidate,
   287	    originatingTo: routeToCandidate,
   288	    accountId: routeAccountIdCandidate,
   289	    messageThreadId: routeThreadIdCandidate,
   290	    explicitDeliverRoute: true,
   291	  };
   292	}

   298	export function explicitOriginTargetsAcpSession(
   299	  origin: ChatSendExplicitOrigin | undefined,
   300	): boolean {
   301	  if (!origin?.originatingChannel || !origin.originatingTo || !origin.accountId) {
   302	    return false;
   303	  }
   304	  const channel = normalizeMessageChannel(origin.originatingChannel);
   305	  if (!channel || channel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   306	    return false;
   307	  }
   308	  const binding = getSessionBindingService().resolveByConversation({
   309	    channel,
   310	    accountId: origin.accountId,
   311	    conversationId: origin.originatingTo,
   312	  });
   313	  return isAcpSessionKey(binding?.targetSessionKey);
   314	}

   335	  value: unknown,
   336	): { ok: true; receipt?: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
   337	  if (value == null) {
   338	    return { ok: true };
   339	  }
   340	  if (typeof value !== "string") {

   346	  }
   347	  const receipt = sanitized.message.trim();
   348	  return { ok: true, receipt: receipt || undefined };

     2	// requester metadata used by delivery policies and media roots.
     3	import { normalizeOptionalString } from "@openclaw/normalization-core/string-coerce";
     4	import { resolveSessionAgentId } from "../../agents/agent-scope.js";
     5	import { normalizeChatType } from "../../channels/chat-type.js";
     6	import type { OpenClawConfig } from "../../config/types.openclaw.js";
     7	import { parseSessionDeliveryRoute } from "../../routing/session-key.js";
     8	import type { SilentReplyConversationType } from "../../shared/silent-reply-policy.js";
     9	
    10	export type OutboundSessionContext = {
    11	  /**
    12	   * Canonical session key used for internal hook dispatch.
    13	   *
    14	   * MUST equal the agent runtime's `params.sessionKey` for the run that
    15	   * produced the payload being delivered. Plugins observing both
    16	   * `agent_end`/`llm_input`/`llm_output`/`before_tool_call`/`after_tool_call`
    17	   * and `message_sending`/`message_sent` rely on this equality to correlate
    18	   * per-turn state across the agent-loop and delivery boundaries.
    19	   *
    20	   * Callers populating this field should use the same value the agent runner
    21	   * received as its sessionKey — in the chat path that is
    22	   * `targetSessionKey || ctx.SessionKey` (see
    23	   * `auto-reply/reply/get-reply.ts`). Followup, ACP, command, and cron
    24	   * delivery paths each have their own canonical value to forward; consult
    25	   * the relevant runner.
    26	   */
    27	  key?: string;
    28	  /**
    29	   * Session key used for policy resolution when delivery differs from the
    30	   * control session. Used to look up silent-reply policy, send rate limits,
    31	   * agent-scoped channel preferences, etc., for the chat the reply is being
    32	   * delivered into. May equal `key` when there is no redirect; otherwise
    33	   * `policyKey` describes the *delivery target*'s session while `key`
    34	   * describes the *control session* whose hooks fire.
    35	   */
    36	  policyKey?: string;
    37	  /** Explicit conversation type for policy resolution when a session key is generic. */
    38	  conversationType?: SilentReplyConversationType;
    39	  /**
    40	   * Caller-declared destination conversation kind for metadata-only audit
    41	   * projection. Never derived from session-key parsing: policy keys can name
    42	   * an acted-on session that is not the delivery destination, and a wrong
    43	   * "direct" here over-collects under audit.messages="direct".
    44	   */
    45	  conversationKind?: "direct" | "group" | "channel";
    46	  /** Active agent id used for workspace-scoped media roots. */
    47	  agentId?: string;
    48	  /** Originating account id used for requester-scoped group policy resolution. */
    49	  requesterAccountId?: string;
    50	  /** Originating sender id used for sender-scoped outbound media policy. */
    51	  requesterSenderId?: string;
    52	  /** Originating sender display name for name-keyed sender policy matching. */
    53	  requesterSenderName?: string;
    54	  /** Originating sender username for username-keyed sender policy matching. */
    55	  requesterSenderUsername?: string;
    56	  /** Originating sender E.164 phone number for e164-keyed sender policy matching. */
    57	  requesterSenderE164?: string;
    58	};
    59	
    60	/** Builds the outbound delivery session context, omitting empty policy fields. */
    61	export function buildOutboundSessionContext(params: {
    62	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
    63	  sessionKey?: string | null;
    64	  policySessionKey?: string | null;
    65	  conversationType?: string | null;
    66	  isGroup?: boolean | null;
    67	  agentId?: string | null;
    68	  requesterAccountId?: string | null;
    69	  requesterSenderId?: string | null;
    70	  requesterSenderName?: string | null;
    71	  requesterSenderUsername?: string | null;
    72	  requesterSenderE164?: string | null;
    73	}): OutboundSessionContext | undefined {
    74	  const key = normalizeOptionalString(params.sessionKey);
    75	  const policyKey = normalizeOptionalString(params.policySessionKey);
    76	  const deliveryRoute = parseSessionDeliveryRoute(policyKey ?? key);
    77	  const declaredChatType = normalizeChatType(params.conversationType ?? undefined);
    78	  const normalizedChatType = declaredChatType ?? normalizeChatType(deliveryRoute?.peerKind);
    79	  // conversationKind feeds the metadata-only audit projection and must carry
    80	  // only caller-declared destination facts. Session-key parses can name a
    81	  // policy/acted-on session that is not this delivery's destination (native
    82	  // command target overrides); a guessed "direct" would over-collect under
    83	  // audit.messages="direct". Destination-gated parsing lives in outbound-audit.
    84	  const conversationKind =
    85	    declaredChatType ??
    86	    (params.isGroup === true ? "group" : params.isGroup === false ? "direct" : undefined);
    87	  // conversationType keeps the historical policy derivation (declared type,
    88	  // then session-key parse, then isGroup) and intentionally folds channels
    89	  // into groups for silent-reply policy.
    90	  const conversationType: SilentReplyConversationType | undefined =
    91	    normalizedChatType === "group" || normalizedChatType === "channel"
    92	      ? "group"
    93	      : normalizedChatType === "direct"
    94	        ? "direct"
    95	        : params.isGroup === true
    96	          ? "group"
    97	          : params.isGroup === false
    98	            ? "direct"
    99	            : undefined;
   100	  const explicitAgentId = normalizeOptionalString(params.agentId);
   101	  const requesterAccountId = normalizeOptionalString(params.requesterAccountId);
   102	  const requesterSenderId = normalizeOptionalString(params.requesterSenderId);
   103	  const requesterSenderName = normalizeOptionalString(params.requesterSenderName);
   104	  const requesterSenderUsername = normalizeOptionalString(params.requesterSenderUsername);
   105	  const requesterSenderE164 = normalizeOptionalString(params.requesterSenderE164);
   106	  const derivedAgentId = key
   107	    ? resolveSessionAgentId({ sessionKey: key, config: params.cfg })
   108	    : undefined;
   109	  // Prefer explicit caller ownership, but derive from the canonical session key
   110	  // so redirected deliveries still get workspace-scoped media policy.
   111	  const agentId = explicitAgentId ?? derivedAgentId;
   112	  if (
   113	    !key &&
   114	    !policyKey &&
   115	    !conversationType &&
   116	    !conversationKind &&
   117	    !agentId &&
   118	    !requesterAccountId &&
   119	    !requesterSenderId &&
   120	    !requesterSenderName &&
   121	    !requesterSenderUsername &&
   122	    !requesterSenderE164
   123	  ) {
   124	    return undefined;
   125	  }
   126	  return {
   127	    ...(key ? { key } : {}),
   128	    ...(policyKey ? { policyKey } : {}),
   129	    ...(conversationType ? { conversationType } : {}),
   130	    ...(conversationKind ? { conversationKind } : {}),
   131	    ...(agentId ? { agentId } : {}),
   132	    ...(requesterAccountId ? { requesterAccountId } : {}),
   133	    ...(requesterSenderId ? { requesterSenderId } : {}),
   134	    ...(requesterSenderName ? { requesterSenderName } : {}),
   135	    ...(requesterSenderUsername ? { requesterSenderUsername } : {}),
   136	    ...(requesterSenderE164 ? { requesterSenderE164 } : {}),
   137	  };
   138	}

     4	const INTERNAL_SESSION_EFFECTS_SEGMENT = "internal-session-effects";
     5	
     6	function normalizeInternalRunId(runId: string): string {
     7	  const readable = runId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_").slice(0, 48) || "run";
     8	  const digest = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(runId).digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
     9	  return `${readable}-${digest}`;
    10	}

    12	/** Resolves the hidden SQLite session identity owned by one internal-effects run. */
    13	export function resolveInternalSessionEffectsIdentity(params: { agentId: string; runId: string }): {
    14	  sessionId: string;
    15	  sessionKey: string;
    16	} {
    17	  const suffix = normalizeInternalRunId(params.runId);
    18	  return {
    19	    sessionId: `${INTERNAL_SESSION_EFFECTS_SEGMENT}-${suffix}`,
    20	    sessionKey: `agent:${normalizeAgentId(params.agentId)}:${INTERNAL_SESSION_EFFECTS_SEGMENT}:${suffix}`,
    21	  };
    22	}
    23	
    24	/** Returns true for SQLite entries that exist only to contain suppressed run effects. */
    25	export function isInternalSessionEffectsKey(sessionKey: string): boolean {
    26	  const parts = sessionKey.split(":");
    27	  return parts.length >= 4 && parts[0] === "agent" && parts[2] === INTERNAL_SESSION_EFFECTS_SEGMENT;
    28	}

   137	/** Classifies a session key/gateway kind into the row category used by tools. */
   138	export function classifySessionKind(params: {
   139	  key: string;
   140	  gatewayKind?: string | null;
   141	  alias: string;
   142	  mainKey: string;
   143	}): SessionKind {
   144	  const key = params.key;
   145	  if (key === params.alias || key === params.mainKey) {
   146	    return "main";
   147	  }
   148	  if (key.startsWith("cron:")) {
   149	    return "cron";
   150	  }
   151	  if (key.startsWith("hook:")) {
   152	    return "hook";
   153	  }
   154	  if (key.startsWith("node-") || key.startsWith("node:")) {
   155	    return "node";
   156	  }
   157	  if (params.gatewayKind === "group") {
   158	    return "group";
   159	  }
   160	  if (key.includes(":group:") || key.includes(":channel:")) {
   161	    // Gateway-less archived rows still encode group/channel shape in the session key.
   162	    return "group";
   163	  }
   164	  return "other";
   165	}

   167	/** Derives the best channel label for a session row. */
   168	export function deriveChannel(params: {
   169	  key: string;

   172	  lastChannel?: string | null;

     1	// Session kind helpers classify cron, interactive, and channel-backed sessions.
     2	import { isCronSessionKey } from "./session-key-utils.js";
     3	
     4	export type SessionKind = "cron" | "direct" | "group" | "global" | "spawn-child" | "unknown";
     5	
     6	/**
     7	 * Classify a session key + entry into a display kind.
     8	 *
     9	 * Evaluation order matters — more-specific signals take priority:
    10	 *   1. sentinel keys ("global", "unknown")
    11	 *   2. cron key shape
    12	 *   3. spawn-child (entry has `spawnedBy`) — checked before key-shape so ACP
    13	 *      spawn-child sessions with opaque keys are not misclassified as "direct"
    14	 *   4. group/channel chatType or key-shape substring
    15	 *   5. fallback: "direct"
    16	 */
    17	export function classifySessionKind(
    18	  key: string,
    19	  entry?: { chatType?: string | null; spawnedBy?: string | null },
    20	): SessionKind {
    21	  if (key === "global") {
    22	    return "global";
    23	  }
    24	  if (key === "unknown") {
    25	    return "unknown";
    26	  }
    27	  if (isCronSessionKey(key)) {
    28	    return "cron";
    29	  }
    30	  if (entry?.spawnedBy) {
    31	    return "spawn-child";
    32	  }
    33	  if (entry?.chatType === "group" || entry?.chatType === "channel") {
    34	    return "group";
    35	  }
    36	  if (key.includes(":group:") || key.includes(":channel:")) {
    37	    return "group";
    38	  }
    39	  return "direct";

    36	export function isDashboardSessionTitleCandidate(params: {
    37	  sessionKey: string;
    38	  userMessage: string;
    39	}): boolean {
    40	  const sourceText = params.userMessage.trim();
    41	  return Boolean(

    43	  );

    46	function resolveDashboardTitleAuthProfile(params: {
    47	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
    48	  agentId: string;
    49	  entry: SessionEntry | undefined;
    50	  regularProvider: string;
    51	}): string | undefined {
    52	  const sessionProfile = params.entry?.authProfileOverride?.trim();
    53	  if (sessionProfile) {
    54	    return sessionProfile;
    55	  }
    56	  const configuredRef = resolveAgentEffectiveModelPrimary(params.cfg, params.agentId)?.trim();
    57	  const configuredProfile = configuredRef
    58	    ? splitTrailingAuthProfile(configuredRef).profile
    59	    : undefined;
    60	  if (!configuredProfile) {
    61	    return undefined;
    62	  }
    63	  const configuredModel = resolveSessionModelRef(params.cfg, undefined, params.agentId);
    64	  return configuredModel.provider === params.regularProvider ? configuredProfile : undefined;
    65	}
    66	
    67	function normalizeDashboardSessionTitle(raw: string): string | null {
    68	  const firstLine = raw
    69	    .replace(/\r/g, "")
    70	    .split("\n")
    71	    .map((line) => line.trim())
    72	    .find((line) => line && !line.startsWith("```"));
    73	  if (!firstLine) {
    74	    return null;
    75	  }
    76	  const unwrapped = firstLine.replace(/^\s*(?:title\s*:\s*)?/i, "").replace(/^["'`]+|["'`]+$/g, "");
    77	  const normalized = unwrapped.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    78	  return normalized ? truncateUtf16Safe(normalized, DASHBOARD_SESSION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS) : null;
    79	}

    81	export async function maybeGenerateDashboardSessionTitle(params: {
    82	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
    83	  agentId: string;
    84	  entry: SessionEntry | undefined;
    85	  sessionId: string;
    86	  sessionKey: string;
    87	  storePath: string;
    88	  userMessage: string;
    89	}): Promise<boolean> {
    90	  const sourceText = params.userMessage.trim();
    91	  if (
    92	    !isDashboardSessionTitleCandidate({
    93	      sessionKey: params.sessionKey,
    94	      userMessage: sourceText,
    95	    }) ||
    96	    hasExplicitSessionName(params.entry) ||
    97	    params.entry?.systemSent === true ||
    98	    params.entry?.sessionId !== params.sessionId
    99	  ) {
   100	    return false;
   101	  }
   102	
   103	  const requestKey = `${params.storePath}\0${params.sessionKey}\0${params.sessionId}`;
   104	  if (dashboardTitleRequests.has(requestKey)) {
   105	    return false;
   106	  }
   107	  dashboardTitleRequests.add(requestKey);
   108	  try {
   109	    const regularModel = resolveSessionModelRef(params.cfg, params.entry, params.agentId);
   110	    const preferredProfile = resolveDashboardTitleAuthProfile({
   111	      cfg: params.cfg,
   112	      agentId: params.agentId,
   113	      entry: params.entry,
   114	      regularProvider: regularModel.provider,
   115	    });
   116	    const regularModelRef = `${regularModel.provider}/${regularModel.model}${
   117	      preferredProfile ? `@${preferredProfile}` : ""
   118	    }`;
   119	    const utilityModelRef = resolveUtilityModelRefForAgent({
   120	      cfg: params.cfg,
   121	      agentId: params.agentId,
   122	      primaryProvider: regularModel.provider,
   123	      primaryModelRef: regularModelRef,
   124	    });
   125	    const generated = await generateConversationLabelWithFallback({
   126	      userMessage: truncateUtf16Safe(sourceText, DASHBOARD_SESSION_TITLE_SOURCE_MAX_CHARS),
   127	      prompt: DASHBOARD_SESSION_TITLE_PROMPT,
   128	      cfg: params.cfg,
   129	      agentId: params.agentId,
   130	      ...(utilityModelRef ? { utilityModelRef } : {}),
   131	      regularModelRef,
   132	      ...(preferredProfile ? { preferredProfile } : {}),
   133	      normalizeLabel: normalizeDashboardSessionTitle,
   134	      maxLength: DASHBOARD_SESSION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS,
   135	    });
   136	    const displayName = generated ? normalizeDashboardSessionTitle(generated) : null;
   137	    if (!displayName) {
   138	      return false;
   139	    }
   140	
   141	    let persisted = false;
   142	    await updateSessionEntry(
   143	      {
   144	        agentId: params.agentId,
   145	        sessionKey: params.sessionKey,
   146	        storePath: params.storePath,
   147	      },
   148	      (current) => {
   149	        if (current.sessionId !== params.sessionId || hasExplicitSessionName(current)) {
   150	          return null;
   151	        }
   152	        persisted = true;
   153	        return { displayName };
   154	      },
   155	      { requireWriteSuccess: true },
   156	    );
   157	    return persisted;
   158	  } finally {
   159	    dashboardTitleRequests.delete(requestKey);
   160	  }
   161	}

   846	            error: errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "failed to resolve parent session for fork"),
   847	          };
   848	        }
   849	        // Operator forks honor the same oversized-parent cap as subagent forks;
   850	        // an explicit fork of an unusable parent fails loudly instead of
   851	        // silently producing an empty child.
   852	        const forkDecision = await resolveParentForkDecision({
   853	          parentEntry: currentParentSessionEntry,

   856	        });

   858	          return {
   859	            ok: false,
   860	            error: errorShape(
   861	              ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST,
   862	              `parent session is too large to fork (${forkDecision.parentTokens}/${forkDecision.maxTokens} tokens)`,
   863	            ),
   864	          };
   865	        }
   866	        const fork = await forkSessionFromParent({
   867	          parentEntry: currentParentSessionEntry,

    74	/** Resolve any incoming session key into the canonical key used in persisted session stores. */
    75	export function resolveSessionStoreKey(params: {
    76	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
    77	  sessionKey: string;
    78	  storeAgentId?: string;
    79	}): string {
    80	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(params.sessionKey) ?? "";
    81	  if (!raw) {
    82	    return raw;
    83	  }
    84	  const rawLower = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw);
    85	  if (rawLower === "global" || rawLower === "unknown") {
    86	    return rawLower;
    87	  }
    88	
    89	  const parsed = parseAgentSessionKey(raw);
    90	  if (parsed) {
    91	    const resolved = resolveParsedSessionStoreKey(params.cfg, raw, parsed, {
    92	      storeAgentId: params.storeAgentId,
    93	    });
    94	    const canonical = canonicalizeMainSessionAlias({
    95	      cfg: params.cfg,
    96	      agentId: resolved.agentId,
    97	      sessionKey: resolved.sessionKey,
    98	    });
    99	    if (canonical !== resolved.sessionKey) {
   100	      return canonical;
   101	    }
   102	    return resolved.sessionKey;
   103	  }
   104	
   105	  const lowered = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw);
   106	  const rawMainKey = normalizeMainKey(params.cfg.session?.mainKey);
   107	  const storeAgentId = params.storeAgentId ? normalizeAgentId(params.storeAgentId) : undefined;
   108	  if (lowered === "main" || lowered === rawMainKey) {
   109	    if (storeAgentId) {
   110	      return resolveAgentMainSessionKey({ cfg: params.cfg, agentId: storeAgentId });
   111	    }
   112	    return resolveMainSessionKey(params.cfg);
   113	  }
   114	  const agentId = storeAgentId ?? resolveDefaultStoreAgentId(params.cfg);
   115	  return canonicalizeSessionKeyForAgent(agentId, raw);
   116	}

  1018	function resolveFreshestSessionStoreMatchFromStoreKeys(
  1019	  store: Record<string, SessionEntry>,
  1020	  storeKeys: string[],
  1021	): { key: string; entry: SessionEntry } | undefined {
  1022	  let freshest: { key: string; entry: SessionEntry } | undefined;
  1023	  for (const key of storeKeys) {
  1024	    const entry = store[key];
  1025	    if (!entry) {
  1026	      continue;
  1027	    }
  1028	    const match = { key, entry };
  1029	    if (!freshest || (match.entry.updatedAt ?? 0) > (freshest.entry.updatedAt ?? 0)) {
  1030	      freshest = match;
  1031	    }
  1032	  }
  1033	  return freshest;
  1034	}

  1043	function findFreshestStoreMatch(
  1044	  store: Record<string, SessionEntry>,
  1045	  ...candidates: string[]
  1046	): { entry: SessionEntry; key: string } | undefined {
  1047	  const matches = new Map<string, { entry: SessionEntry; key: string }>();
  1048	  for (const candidate of candidates) {
  1049	    const trimmed = normalizeOptionalString(candidate) ?? "";
  1050	    if (!trimmed) {
  1051	      continue;
  1052	    }
  1053	    const exact = store[trimmed];
  1054	    if (exact) {
  1055	      matches.set(trimmed, { entry: exact, key: trimmed });
  1056	    }
  1057	  }
  1058	  if (matches.size === 0) {
  1059	    return undefined;
  1060	  }
  1061	  let freshest: { entry: SessionEntry; key: string } | undefined;
  1062	  for (const match of matches.values()) {
  1063	    if (!freshest || (match.entry.updatedAt ?? 0) > (freshest.entry.updatedAt ?? 0)) {
  1064	      freshest = match;
  1065	    }
  1066	  }
  1067	  return freshest;
  1068	}

  1506	    agentId: legacyAgentId,
  1507	    storePath: best.storePath,
  1508	    canonicalKey,
  1509	    storeKeys: Array.from(storeKeys),
  1510	    store: best.store,
  1511	  };
  1512	}
  1513	
  1514	export function resolveGatewaySessionStoreTargetWithStore(params: {
  1515	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
  1516	  key: string;
  1517	  agentId?: string;
  1518	  clone?: boolean;
  1519	  readOnly?: boolean;
  1520	  store?: Record<string, SessionEntry>;
  1521	}): GatewaySessionStoreTargetWithStore {
  1522	  const key = normalizeOptionalString(params.key) ?? "";
  1523	  const explicitDeletedMainTarget = resolveExplicitDeletedLegacyMainStoreTarget({
  1524	    cfg: params.cfg,
  1525	    key,
  1526	    clone: params.clone,
  1527	    readOnly: params.readOnly,
  1528	  });
  1529	  if (explicitDeletedMainTarget) {
  1530	    return explicitDeletedMainTarget;
  1531	  }
  1532	
  1533	  const requestedAgentId = normalizeOptionalString(params.agentId);
  1534	  const canonicalKey = resolveSessionStoreKey({
  1535	    cfg: params.cfg,
  1536	    sessionKey: key,
  1537	    ...(requestedAgentId ? { storeAgentId: requestedAgentId } : {}),
  1538	  });
  1539	  const agentId =
  1540	    requestedAgentId &&
  1541	    (isAgentScopedSentinelSessionKey(canonicalKey) || !parseAgentSessionKey(key))
  1542	      ? normalizeAgentId(requestedAgentId)
  1543	      : resolveSessionStoreAgentId(params.cfg, canonicalKey);
  1544	  const { storePath, store } = resolveGatewaySessionStoreLookup({
  1545	    cfg: params.cfg,
  1546	    key,
  1547	    canonicalKey,
  1548	    agentId,
  1549	    clone: params.clone,
  1550	    readOnly: params.readOnly,
  1551	    initialStore: params.store,
  1552	  });
  1553	
  1554	  if (canonicalKey === "global" || canonicalKey === "unknown") {
  1555	    const storeKeys = key && key !== canonicalKey ? [canonicalKey, key] : [key];
  1556	    return { agentId, storePath, canonicalKey, storeKeys, store };
  1557	  }
  1558	
  1559	  const storeKeys = new Set<string>(
  1560	    buildGatewaySessionStoreScanTargets({ cfg: params.cfg, key, canonicalKey, agentId }),
  1561	  );
  1562	  return {
  1563	    agentId,
  1564	    storePath,
  1565	    canonicalKey,
  1566	    storeKeys: Array.from(storeKeys),
  1567	    store,
  1568	  };
  1569	}
  1570	
  1571	export function resolveGatewaySessionStoreTarget(params: {
  1572	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
  1573	  key: string;
  1574	  agentId?: string;
  1575	  clone?: boolean;
  1576	  store?: Record<string, SessionEntry>;
  1577	}): GatewaySessionStoreTarget {
  1578	  const { store: _store, ...target } = resolveGatewaySessionStoreTargetWithStore(params);
  1579	  return target;
  1580	}

   112	}

   116	function canDeliverApprovals(
   117	  gatewayClient: GatewayRequestContextClient,
   118	  approvalKind: "exec" | "plugin" | "system-agent",
   119	): boolean {
   120	  if (gatewayClient.invalidated) {
   121	    return false;
   122	  }
   123	  const scopes = Array.isArray(gatewayClient.connect.scopes) ? gatewayClient.connect.scopes : [];
   124	  const hasApprovalScope =
   125	    scopes.includes("operator.admin") || scopes.includes("operator.approvals");
   126	  if (!hasApprovalScope) {
   127	    return false;
   128	  }
   129	  // Scope grants approval access; it does not prove the client renders this approval kind.
   130	  // Stable ids preserve shipped clients while explicit caps describe newer non-UI bridges.
   131	  return (
   132	    gatewayClient.internal?.approvalRuntime === true ||
   133	    ALL_APPROVAL_CLIENT_IDS.has(gatewayClient.connect.client.id) ||
   134	    hasGatewayClientCap(gatewayClient.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.APPROVALS) ||
   135	    (approvalKind === "exec" &&
   136	      (EXEC_APPROVAL_CLIENT_IDS.has(gatewayClient.connect.client.id) ||
   137	        hasGatewayClientCap(gatewayClient.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.EXEC_APPROVALS))) ||
   138	    (approvalKind === "plugin" &&
   139	      (PLUGIN_APPROVAL_CLIENT_IDS.has(gatewayClient.connect.client.id) ||
   140	        hasGatewayClientCap(gatewayClient.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.PLUGIN_APPROVALS)))
   141	  );
   142	}

     1	import type {
     2	  PendingApprovalSnapshot,
     3	  SessionApprovalEvent,
     4	  SessionApprovalReplay,
     5	} from "../../packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.js";
     6	import type { OpenClawStateDatabaseOptions } from "../state/openclaw-state-db.js";
     7	import { resolveApprovalSourceStreamKey } from "./approval-session-audience.js";
     8	import { normalizeControlUiBasePath } from "./control-ui-shared.js";
     9	import type { OperatorApprovalLifecycleEvent } from "./exec-approval-manager.js";
    10	import { canAccessOperatorApproval } from "./operator-approval-authorization.js";
    11	import { projectOperatorApprovalSnapshot } from "./operator-approval-snapshot.js";
    12	import {
    13	  expireDueOperatorApprovals,
    14	  listPendingOperatorApprovals,
    15	  type OperatorApprovalRecord,
    16	} from "./operator-approval-store.js";
    17	import type { GatewayBroadcastToConnIdsFn } from "./server-broadcast-types.js";
    18	import type { SessionMessageSubscriberRegistry } from "./server-chat-state.js";
    19	import type { GatewayClient } from "./server-methods/types.js";
    20	
    21	const MAX_SESSION_APPROVAL_REPLAY = 1_000;
    22	type ApprovalSessionClient = GatewayClient & { invalidated?: boolean };
    23	
    24	type OperatorApprovalSessionEventRuntime = {
    25	  publish: (event: OperatorApprovalLifecycleEvent) => void;
    26	  replay: (sessionKey: string, client: GatewayClient | null) => SessionApprovalReplay;
    27	};
    28	
    29	/** Project durable approval truth to exact, explicitly opted-in session audiences. */
    30	export function createOperatorApprovalSessionEventRuntime(params: {
    31	  clients: Iterable<ApprovalSessionClient>;
    32	  sessionMessageSubscribers: Pick<SessionMessageSubscriberRegistry, "getApprovals">;
    33	  broadcastToConnIds: GatewayBroadcastToConnIdsFn;
    34	  controlUiBasePath?: string;
    35	  databaseOptions?: OpenClawStateDatabaseOptions;
    36	  now?: () => number;
    37	  reconcileTerminal?: (record: OperatorApprovalRecord) => boolean;
    38	}): OperatorApprovalSessionEventRuntime {
    39	  const controlUiBasePath = normalizeControlUiBasePath(params.controlUiBasePath);
    40	  const now = params.now ?? Date.now;
    41	
    42	  const canAccessRecord = (client: GatewayClient | null, record: OperatorApprovalRecord): boolean =>
    43	    canAccessOperatorApproval({
    44	      client,
    45	      binding: { reviewerDeviceIds: record.reviewerDeviceIds },
    46	    });
    47	
    48	  const authorizedRecipients = (
    49	    sessionKey: string,
    50	    record: OperatorApprovalRecord,
    51	  ): ReadonlySet<string> => {
    52	    const subscribed = params.sessionMessageSubscribers.getApprovals(sessionKey);
    53	    if (subscribed.size === 0) {
    54	      return subscribed;
    55	    }
    56	    const recipients = new Set<string>();
    57	    for (const client of params.clients) {
    58	      const connId = client.connId;
    59	      if (
    60	        !client.invalidated &&
    61	        connId &&
    62	        subscribed.has(connId) &&
    63	        canAccessRecord(client, record)
    64	      ) {
    65	        recipients.add(connId);
    66	      }
    67	    }
    68	    return recipients;
    69	  };
    70	
    71	  const publish = (event: OperatorApprovalLifecycleEvent): void => {
    72	    const approval = projectOperatorApprovalSnapshot(event.record, controlUiBasePath);
    73	    if (!approval || event.record.audienceSessionKeys.length === 0) {
    74	      return;
    75	    }
    76	    // The audience walk seeds the fully canonicalized source stream key as its
    77	    // first entry; publish that exact form so parents can correlate the event
    78	    // with a stream key they subscribed to. Raw source aliases (bare "global",
    79	    // "main", unscoped child keys) never reach subscribers.
    80	    const sourceStreamKey =
    81	      event.record.audienceSessionKeys[0] ??
    82	      (event.record.source.sessionKey
    83	        ? resolveApprovalSourceStreamKey(
    84	            event.record.source.sessionKey,
    85	            event.record.source.agentId,
    86	          )
    87	        : null);
    88	    for (const sessionKey of event.record.audienceSessionKeys) {
    89	      const recipients = authorizedRecipients(sessionKey, event.record);
    90	      if (recipients.size === 0) {
    91	        continue;
    92	      }
    93	      const common = {
    94	        sessionKey,
    95	        ...(sourceStreamKey ? { sourceSessionKey: sourceStreamKey } : {}),
    96	        updatedAtMs: event.record.updatedAtMs,
    97	      };
    98	      let payload: SessionApprovalEvent;
    99	      if (event.phase === "pending") {
   100	        if (approval.status !== "pending") {
   101	          continue;
   102	        }
   103	        payload = { ...common, phase: "pending", approval };
   104	      } else {
   105	        if (approval.status === "pending") {
   106	          continue;
   107	        }
   108	        payload = { ...common, phase: "terminal", approval };
   109	      }
   110	      params.broadcastToConnIds("session.approval", payload, recipients);
   111	    }
   112	  };
   113	
   114	  return {
   115	    publish,
   116	    replay: (sessionKey, client) => {
   117	      const snapshotAtMs = now();
   118	      const expired = expireDueOperatorApprovals({
   119	        nowMs: snapshotAtMs,
   120	        databaseOptions: params.databaseOptions,
   121	      });
   122	      // A replay read can be the first observer after a suspended timer. Emit
   123	      // the durable timeout tombstone before returning the authoritative set.
   124	      for (const record of expired.records) {
   125	        if (params.reconcileTerminal?.(record) !== true) {
   126	          publish({ phase: "terminal", record });
   127	        }
   128	      }
   129	      const approvals: PendingApprovalSnapshot[] = [];
   130	      const records = listPendingOperatorApprovals({
   131	        audienceSessionKey: sessionKey,
   132	        recordFilter: (record) => canAccessRecord(client, record),
   133	        limit: MAX_SESSION_APPROVAL_REPLAY + 1,
   134	        nowMs: snapshotAtMs,
   135	        databaseOptions: params.databaseOptions,
   136	      });
   137	      const truncated = records.length > MAX_SESSION_APPROVAL_REPLAY;
   138	      for (const record of records) {
   139	        if (approvals.length === MAX_SESSION_APPROVAL_REPLAY) {
   140	          return { sessionKey, updatedAtMs: snapshotAtMs, approvals, truncated: true };
   141	        }
   142	        const approval = projectOperatorApprovalSnapshot(record, controlUiBasePath);
   143	        if (approval?.status === "pending") {
   144	          approvals.push(approval);
   145	        }
   146	      }
   147	      return { sessionKey, updatedAtMs: snapshotAtMs, approvals, truncated };
   148	    },
   149	  };
   150	}

    29	  return params.canonicalKey === "global" && agentId
    30	    ? `agent:${agentId}:global`
    31	    : params.canonicalKey;
    32	}

    46	    }

    80	      respond(false, undefined, requestedAgent.error);

    82	    }

    86	      canonicalKey,
    87	      agentId: requestedAgentId,
    88	      defaultAgentId: resolveDefaultAgentId(cfg),
    89	    });

    99	        );

   101	          approvalReplay = context.listSessionPendingApprovals?.(subscriptionKey, client);

   106	            false,
   107	            undefined,
   108	            errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "session approval replay unavailable"),
   109	          );
   110	          return;
   111	        }
   112	        if (!approvalReplay) {
   113	          rollbackSubscription?.();
   114	          respond(
   115	            false,
   116	            undefined,
   117	            errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "session approval replay unavailable"),
   118	          );
   119	          return;
   120	        }
   121	        rollbackSubscription?.commit?.();
   122	      } else {
   123	        context.subscribeSessionMessageEvents(connId, subscriptionKey);
   124	      }
   125	      respond(
   126	        true,
   127	        {
   128	          subscribed: true,
   129	          key: canonicalKey,
   130	          ...(p.includeApprovals === true
   131	            ? {
   132	                approvalReplay,
   133	              }
   134	            : {}),
   135	        },
   136	        undefined,
   137	      );
   138	      return;
   139	    }
   140	    respond(true, { subscribed: false, key: canonicalKey }, undefined);
   141	  },

     9	function normalizeIdentity(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    10	  return normalizeOptionalString(value) ?? null;
    11	}
    12	
    13	function normalizeIdentities(values: readonly string[] | null | undefined): string[] {
    14	  const normalized = new Set<string>();
    15	  for (const value of values ?? []) {
    16	    const identity = normalizeIdentity(value);
    17	    if (identity) {
    18	      normalized.add(identity);
    19	    }
    20	  }

    24	/** Whether a client may inspect safe approval projections. */
    25	export function canReviewOperatorApproval(client: GatewayClient | null): boolean {
    26	  const scopes = Array.isArray(client?.connect?.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
    27	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
    28	    return true;
    29	  }
    30	  if (!scopes.includes(APPROVALS_SCOPE)) {
    31	    return false;
    32	  }
    33	  return Boolean(normalizeOptionalString(client?.connect?.device?.id));
    34	}

    36	/** Whether a client may submit an approval verdict. */
    37	export function canResolveOperatorApproval(client: GatewayClient | null): boolean {
    38	  // approvalRuntime is server-authenticated connection metadata. Public request
    39	  // fields cannot mint this device-less resolver authority.
    40	  const scopes = Array.isArray(client?.connect?.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
    41	  const isTrustedApprovalRuntime =
    42	    client?.internal?.approvalRuntime === true && scopes.includes(APPROVALS_SCOPE);
    43	  return isTrustedApprovalRuntime || canReviewOperatorApproval(client);
    44	}
    45	
    46	/** Whether a broadly authorized client may access one bound approval record. */
    47	export function canAccessOperatorApproval(params: {
    48	  client: GatewayClient | null;
    49	  binding: OperatorApprovalAccessBinding;
    50	  allowApprovalRuntime?: boolean;
    51	}): boolean {
    52	  const broadlyAuthorized = params.allowApprovalRuntime
    53	    ? canResolveOperatorApproval(params.client)
    54	    : canReviewOperatorApproval(params.client);
    55	  if (!broadlyAuthorized) {
    56	    return false;
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  const scopes = Array.isArray(params.client?.connect?.scopes) ? params.client.connect.scopes : [];
    60	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
    61	    return true;
    62	  }
    63	  if (params.allowApprovalRuntime && params.client?.internal?.approvalRuntime === true) {
    64	    return true;
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  const clientDeviceId = normalizeIdentity(params.client?.connect?.device?.id);
    68	  const reviewerDeviceIds = normalizeIdentities(params.binding.reviewerDeviceIds);
    69	  if (reviewerDeviceIds.length > 0) {
    70	    return Boolean(clientDeviceId && reviewerDeviceIds.includes(clientDeviceId));
    71	  }
    72	
    73	  // No explicit reviewer binding: the operator.approvals scope tier is the
    74	  // access authority, matching the shipped contract where any authorized
    75	  // approval surface (Telegram buttons, macOS app, control UI) may resolve
    76	  // any pending approval. Cross-surface first-answer-wins depends on this;
    77	  // reviewerDeviceIds is the opt-in restriction, and requester identity gates
    78	  // only the legacy adapters in approval-shared.
    79	  return true;
    80	}

    92	function serializeFrameField(name: "payload" | "stateVersion", value: unknown): string {
    93	  // Serialize one field through JSON.stringify so embedded values keep JSON
    94	  // escaping, then splice it into the shared per-client frame body.
    95	  const fieldJSON = JSON.stringify({ [name]: value });
    96	  const keyJSON = JSON.stringify(name);
    97	  const prefix = `{${keyJSON}:`;
    98	  return fieldJSON.startsWith(prefix) ? `,${keyJSON}:${fieldJSON.slice(prefix.length, -1)}` : "";
    99	}

   136	export function isApprovalRecordVisibleToClient<TPayload>(params: {
   137	  record: ExecApprovalRecord<TPayload>;
   138	  client: GatewayClient | null;
   139	}): boolean {
   140	  const scopes = Array.isArray(params.client?.connect?.scopes) ? params.client.connect.scopes : [];
   141	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
   142	    return true;
   143	  }
   144	
   145	  const requestedByDeviceId = normalizeApprovalIdentity(params.record.requestedByDeviceId);
   146	  const requestedByClientId = normalizeApprovalIdentity(params.record.requestedByClientId);
   147	  const hasApprovalsScope = scopes.includes(APPROVALS_SCOPE);
   148	  if (hasApprovalsScope && params.client?.internal?.approvalRuntime === true) {
   149	    return true;
   150	  }
   151	
   152	  const approvalReviewerDeviceIds = normalizeApprovalIdentities(
   153	    params.record.approvalReviewerDeviceIds,
   154	  );
   155	  const clientDeviceId = normalizeApprovalIdentity(params.client?.connect?.device?.id);
   156	  if (hasApprovalsScope && clientDeviceId && approvalReviewerDeviceIds.includes(clientDeviceId)) {
   157	    return true;
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  // Shipped legacy adapters retain exact requester connection/device authority.
   161	  // Unified durable methods apply their separate record authorization after lookup.
   162	  if (requestedByDeviceId) {
   163	    return requestedByDeviceId === clientDeviceId;
   164	  }
   165	
   166	  const requestedByConnId = normalizeApprovalIdentity(params.record.requestedByConnId);
   167	  if (requestedByConnId) {
   168	    return requestedByConnId === normalizeApprovalIdentity(params.client?.connId);
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  if (requestedByClientId || approvalReviewerDeviceIds.length > 0) {
   172	    return false;
   173	  }
   174	
   175	  // Unbound approvals predate requester metadata and remain visible so pending
   176	  // work can still be resolved after upgrades or gateway restarts.
   177	  return true;
   178	}

   258	  return {
   259	    id: record.id,
   260	    request: record.request,
   261	    createdAtMs: record.createdAtMs,
   262	    expiresAtMs: record.expiresAtMs,
   263	  };
   264	}

   266	/** Validates approval resolve params and narrows the decision to the supported enum. */
   267	export function resolveApprovalDecisionParams<TParams extends ApprovalResolveParams>(params: {
   268	  rawParams: unknown;
   269	  validate: ApprovalResolveParamsValidator<TParams>;
   270	  methodName: string;
   271	  respond: RespondFn;
   272	}): { inputId: string; decision: ExecApprovalDecision } | null {
   273	  const rawParams = params.rawParams;
   274	  if (!params.validate(rawParams)) {
   275	    params.respond(
   276	      false,
   277	      undefined,
   278	      errorShape(
   279	        ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST,
   280	        `invalid ${params.methodName} params: ${formatValidationErrors(params.validate.errors)}`,
   281	      ),
   282	    );
   283	    return null;
   284	  }
   285	  if (!isApprovalDecision(rawParams.decision)) {
   286	    params.respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "invalid decision"));
   287	    return null;
   288	  }
   289	  return {
   290	    inputId: rawParams.id,
   291	    decision: rawParams.decision,
   292	  };
   293	}

   295	/** Resolves the approval clients that should receive request or resolution events. */
   296	export function resolveApprovalRequestRecipientConnIds<TPayload>(params: {
   297	  approvalKind: "exec" | "plugin" | "system-agent";
   298	  context: GatewayRequestContext;
   299	  record: ExecApprovalRecord<TPayload>;
   300	  excludeConnId?: string;
   301	}): ReadonlySet<string> | null {
   302	  return (
   303	    params.context.getApprovalClientConnIds?.({
   304	      approvalKind: params.approvalKind,
   305	      excludeConnId: params.excludeConnId,
   306	      record: params.record,
   307	      filter: (client) =>
   308	        isApprovalRecordVisibleToClient({
   309	          record: params.record,
   310	          client,
   311	        }),
   312	    }) ?? null
   313	  );
   314	}

   316	/** Finds a pending approval by full id or prefix after applying client visibility rules. */
   317	export function resolvePendingApprovalRecord<TPayload>(params: {
   318	  manager: ExecApprovalManager<TPayload>;
   319	  inputId: string;
   320	  client?: GatewayClient | null;
   321	  exposeAmbiguousPrefixError?: boolean;
   322	}): ApprovalRecordLookupResult<TPayload> {
   323	  return resolveApprovalRecordForState(params, "pending");
   324	}

   326	function resolveResolvedApprovalRecord<TPayload>(params: {
   327	  manager: ExecApprovalManager<TPayload>;
   328	  inputId: string;
   329	  client?: GatewayClient | null;
   330	  exposeAmbiguousPrefixError?: boolean;
   331	}): ApprovalRecordLookupResult<TPayload> {
   332	  return resolveApprovalRecordForState(params, "resolved");
   333	}
   334	
   335	function resolveApprovalRecordForState<TPayload>(
   336	  params: {
   337	    manager: ExecApprovalManager<TPayload>;
   338	    inputId: string;
   339	    client?: GatewayClient | null;
   340	    exposeAmbiguousPrefixError?: boolean;
   341	  },
   342	  expectedState: "pending" | "resolved",
   343	): ApprovalRecordLookupResult<TPayload> {
   344	  const resolvedId = params.manager.lookupApprovalId(params.inputId, {
   345	    includeResolved: expectedState === "resolved",
   346	    filter: (record) =>
   347	      isApprovalRecordVisibleToClient({
   348	        record,
   349	        client: params.client ?? null,
   350	      }),
   351	  });
   352	  if (resolvedId.kind !== "exact" && resolvedId.kind !== "prefix") {
   353	    return {
   354	      ok: false,
   355	      response: resolvePendingApprovalLookupError({
   356	        resolvedId,
   357	        exposeAmbiguousPrefixError: params.exposeAmbiguousPrefixError,
   358	      }),
   359	    };
   360	  }
   361	  const snapshot = params.manager.getSnapshot(resolvedId.id);
   362	  const isResolved = snapshot?.resolvedAtMs !== undefined;
   363	  if (!snapshot || isResolved !== (expectedState === "resolved")) {
   364	    return { ok: false, response: "missing" };
   365	  }
   366	  return { ok: true, approvalId: resolvedId.id, snapshot };
   367	}
   368	
   369	export function respondPendingApprovalLookupError(params: {
   370	  respond: RespondFn;
   371	  response: PendingApprovalLookupError;
   372	}): void {
   373	  if (params.response === "missing") {
   374	    respondUnknownOrExpiredApproval(params.respond);
   375	    return;
   376	  }
   377	  params.respond(false, undefined, errorShape(params.response.code, params.response.message));
   378	}

   380	export async function handleApprovalWaitDecision<TPayload>(params: {
   381	  manager: ExecApprovalManager<TPayload>;
   382	  inputId: unknown;
   383	  client?: GatewayClient | null;
   384	  respond: RespondFn;
   385	  resolveTerminalReason?: WaitReasonResolver<TPayload>;
   386	}): Promise<void> {
   387	  const id = normalizeOptionalString(params.inputId) ?? "";
   388	  if (!id) {
   389	    params.respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "id is required"));
   390	    return;
   391	  }
   392	  const snapshot = params.manager.getSnapshot(id);
   393	  if (
   394	    !snapshot ||
   395	    !isApprovalRecordVisibleToClient({
   396	      record: snapshot,
   397	      client: params.client ?? null,
   398	    })
   399	  ) {
   400	    params.respond(
   401	      false,
   402	      undefined,
   403	      errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "approval expired or not found"),
   404	    );
   405	    return;
   406	  }
   407	  const decisionPromise = params.manager.awaitDecision(id);
   408	  if (!decisionPromise) {
   409	    params.respond(
   410	      false,
   411	      undefined,
   412	      errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "approval expired or not found"),
   413	    );
   414	    return;
   415	  }
   416	  const decision = await decisionPromise;
   417	  const terminalSnapshot = params.manager.getSnapshot(id) ?? snapshot;
   418	  const terminalReason = params.resolveTerminalReason?.(terminalSnapshot);
   419	  params.respond(
   420	    true,
   421	    buildWaitResponse(id, decision, terminalSnapshot, terminalReason),
   422	    undefined,
   423	  );
   424	}

   426	/** Broadcasts or routes a pending approval request, then responds after acceptance/decision. */
   427	export async function handlePendingApprovalRequest<
   428	  TPayload extends ApprovalTurnSourceFields,
   429	>(params: {
   430	  manager: ExecApprovalManager<TPayload>;

   434	  context: GatewayRequestContext;
   435	  clientConnId?: string;
   436	  requestEventName: string;
   437	  requestEvent: RequestedApprovalEvent<TPayload>;
   438	  twoPhase: boolean;
   439	  approvalKind?: "exec" | "plugin";
   440	  deliverRequest: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
   441	  afterDecision?: (
   442	    decision: ExecApprovalDecision | null,
   443	    requestEvent: RequestedApprovalEvent<TPayload>,
   444	  ) => Promise<void> | void;
   445	  afterDecisionErrorLabel?: string;
   446	  keepPendingWithoutRoute?: boolean;
   447	  requireDeliveryRoute?: boolean;
   448	  suppressDelivery?: boolean;
   449	}): Promise<void> {
   450	  // Delivery may outlive the normal resolved-record grace. Keep the executable
   451	  // binding until the requester response and post-decision handoff finish.
   452	  const releaseHandoff = params.manager.retainForHandoff(params.record.id);
   453	  try {
   454	    const suppressDelivery = params.suppressDelivery === true;
   455	    const approvalClientConnIds = suppressDelivery
   456	      ? null
   457	      : resolveApprovalRequestRecipientConnIds({
   458	          approvalKind: params.approvalKind ?? "exec",
   459	          context: params.context,
   460	          record: params.record,
   461	          excludeConnId: params.clientConnId,
   462	        });
   463	    if (!suppressDelivery) {
   464	      if (approvalClientConnIds) {
   465	        params.context.broadcastToConnIds(
   466	          params.requestEventName,
   467	          params.requestEvent,
   468	          approvalClientConnIds,
   469	          {
   470	            dropIfSlow: true,
   471	          },
   472	        );
   473	      } else {
   474	        params.context.broadcast(params.requestEventName, params.requestEvent, {
   475	          dropIfSlow: true,
   476	        });
   477	      }
   478	    }
   479	    const internalApprovalSubscriberCount = suppressDelivery
   480	      ? 0
   481	      : (params.context.approvalEvents?.publishRequested(
   482	          params.approvalKind ?? "exec",
   483	          params.requestEvent,
   484	        ) ?? 0);
   485	
   486	    const hasApprovalClients = suppressDelivery
   487	      ? false
   488	      : approvalClientConnIds !== null
   489	        ? approvalClientConnIds.size > 0 || internalApprovalSubscriberCount > 0
   490	        : (params.context.hasExecApprovalClients?.(params.clientConnId) ?? false) ||
   491	          internalApprovalSubscriberCount > 0;
   492	    const deliveredResult = suppressDelivery ? false : params.deliverRequest();
   493	    const delivered = isPromiseLike(deliveredResult) ? await deliveredResult : deliveredResult;
   494	    // A turn-source route can approve without an active approval client, so keep
   495	    // the record alive when the originating channel/account can still receive it.
   496	    const hasTurnSourceRoute =
   497	      !hasApprovalClients &&
   498	      !delivered &&
   499	      hasApprovalTurnSourceRoute({
   500	        turnSourceChannel: params.record.request.turnSourceChannel,
   501	        turnSourceAccountId: params.record.request.turnSourceAccountId,
   502	        approvalKind: params.approvalKind ?? "exec",
   503	      });
   504	    const deliveryRoute: ApprovalRequestDeliveryRoute = delivered
   505	      ? "forwarder"
   506	      : hasApprovalClients
   507	        ? "approval-client"
   508	        : hasTurnSourceRoute
   509	          ? "turn-source"
   510	          : "none";
   511	
   512	    const respondWithDecision = async (decision: ExecApprovalDecision | null): Promise<void> => {
   513	      if (params.afterDecision) {
   514	        try {
   515	          await params.afterDecision(decision, params.requestEvent);
   516	        } catch (err) {
   517	          params.context.logGateway?.error?.(
   518	            `${params.afterDecisionErrorLabel ?? "approval follow-up failed"}: ${String(err)}`,
   519	          );
   520	        }
   521	      }
   522	      params.respond(
   523	        true,
   524	        {
   525	          id: params.record.id,
   526	          decision,
   527	          createdAtMs: params.record.createdAtMs,
   528	          expiresAtMs: params.record.expiresAtMs,
   529	        },
   530	        undefined,
   531	      );
   532	    };
   533	
   534	    if (
   535	      params.requireDeliveryRoute !== false &&
   536	      !params.keepPendingWithoutRoute &&
   537	      !hasApprovalClients &&
   538	      !hasTurnSourceRoute &&
   539	      !delivered
   540	    ) {
   185	    getHealthVersion: params.getHealthVersion,
   186	    broadcast: params.broadcast,
   187	    broadcastToConnIds: params.broadcastToConnIds,
   188	    nodeSendToSession: params.nodeSendToSession,
   189	    nodeSendToAllSubscribed: params.nodeSendToAllSubscribed,
   190	    nodeSubscribe: params.nodeSubscribe,

   231	        }

   236	      }
   237	      return connIds;
   238	    },
   239	    hasConnectedClientsForDevice: (deviceId: string) => {
   240	      for (const gatewayClient of params.clients) {
   241	        if (gatewayClient.connect.device?.id === deviceId && !gatewayClient.invalidated) {
   242	          return true;
   243	        }
   244	      }
   245	      return false;

   251	          continue;

   118	          );

   230	          errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "systemRunPlan is required for host=node"),
   231	        );
   232	        return;
   233	      }
   234	      if (effectiveCommandText.trim().length === 0) {
   235	        respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "command is required"));
   236	        return;
   237	      }

   245	          ),

   273	          undefined,
   274	          errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "command exceeds exec approval display limit", {
   275	            details: {
   276	              reason: "EXEC_APPROVAL_COMMAND_DISPLAY_LIMIT",
   277	            },
   278	          }),
   279	        );
   280	        return;
   281	      }
   282	      const sanitizedCommandText = sanitizedCommandDisplay.text;
   283	      const commandAnalysis = await resolveCommandAnalysisSummaryForDisplay({
   284	        host,
   285	        commandText: effectiveCommandText,
   286	        commandArgv: effectiveCommandArgv,
   287	        cwd: effectiveCwd,
   288	        sanitizeText: sanitizeExecApprovalWarningText,
   289	      });

   291	        commandHighlighting && sanitizedCommandText === effectiveCommandText
   292	          ? normalizeCommandSpans(p.commandSpans, sanitizedCommandText.length)
   293	          : undefined;
   294	      const systemRunBinding =
   295	        host === "node"
   296	          ? buildSystemRunApprovalBinding({
   297	              argv: effectiveCommandArgv,
   298	              cwd: effectiveCwd,
   299	              agentId: effectiveAgentId,
   300	              sessionKey: effectiveSessionKey,
   301	              env: p.env,
   302	            })
   303	          : null;

   305	        respond(
   306	          false,
   307	          undefined,
   308	          errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "approval id already pending"),
   309	        );
   310	        return;

   346	        turnSourceAccountId: normalizeOptionalString(p.turnSourceAccountId) ?? null,

   889	function resolvePermittedPluginApprovalResolution(
   890	  decision: unknown,
   891	  allowedDecisions: readonly string[],
   892	): PluginApprovalResolution {
   893	  if (
   894	    (decision === PluginApprovalResolutions.ALLOW_ONCE ||
   895	      decision === PluginApprovalResolutions.ALLOW_ALWAYS ||
   896	      decision === PluginApprovalResolutions.DENY) &&
   897	    allowedDecisions.includes(decision)
   898	  ) {
   899	    return decision;
   900	  }
   901	  return PluginApprovalResolutions.TIMEOUT;
   902	}
