   904	function buildPluginApprovalFailureReason(params: {
   905	  fallbackReason: string;
   906	  ctx?: HookContext;
   907	}): string {
   908	  const turnSourceChannel = params.ctx?.turnSourceChannel;
   909	  if (!turnSourceChannel?.trim()) {
   910	    return params.fallbackReason;
   911	  }
   912	  const nativePluginSurface = resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState({
   913	    channel: turnSourceChannel,
   914	    accountId: params.ctx?.turnSourceAccountId,
   915	    cfg: params.ctx?.config,
   916	    approvalKind: "plugin",
   917	  });
   918	  const setupText = describeNativePluginApprovalClientSetup({
   919	    channel: nativePluginSurface.channel,
   920	    channelLabel: nativePluginSurface.channelLabel,
   921	    accountId: nativePluginSurface.accountId,
   922	  });
   923	  if (!setupText) {
   924	    return params.fallbackReason;
   925	  }
   926	  const nativeDeliverySurface =
   927	    nativePluginSurface.kind === "disabled"
   928	      ? nativePluginSurface
   929	      : resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState({
   930	          channel: turnSourceChannel,
   931	          accountId: params.ctx?.turnSourceAccountId,
   932	          cfg: params.ctx?.config,
   933	          approvalKind: "exec",
   934	        });
   935	  if (nativeDeliverySurface.kind !== "disabled") {
   936	    return params.fallbackReason;
   937	  }
   938	  return `${params.fallbackReason}\n\n${setupText}`;
   939	}
   940	
   941	async function requestPluginToolApproval(params: {
   942	  approval: PluginApprovalRequest;
   943	  toolName: string;
   944	  toolCallId?: string;
   945	  ctx?: HookContext;
   946	  signal?: AbortSignal;
   947	  baseParams: unknown;
   948	  overrideParams?: unknown;
   949	}): Promise<HookOutcome> {
   950	  const approval = params.approval;
   951	  const timeoutMs = resolvePluginToolApprovalTimeoutMs(approval);
   952	  const gatewayTimeoutMs = resolvePluginToolApprovalGatewayTimeoutMs(timeoutMs);
   953	  const allowedDecisions = resolveCanonicalPluginApprovalRequestAllowedDecisions(approval);
   954	  let gatewayApprovalPhase: "none" | "request" | "wait" = "none";
   955	  try {
   956	    const embeddedApprovalBroker = isEmbeddedMode() ? getEmbeddedPluginApprovalBroker() : null;
   957	    if (embeddedApprovalBroker) {
   958	      const result = await embeddedApprovalBroker.request({
   959	        request: {
   960	          pluginId: approval.pluginId,
   961	          title: approval.title,
   962	          description: approval.description,
   963	          severity: approval.severity,
   964	          allowedDecisions: approval.allowedDecisions,
   965	          toolName: params.toolName,
   966	          toolCallId: params.toolCallId,
   967	          agentId: params.ctx?.agentId,
   968	          sessionKey: params.ctx?.sessionKey,
   969	          turnSourceChannel: params.ctx?.turnSourceChannel,
   970	          turnSourceTo: params.ctx?.turnSourceTo,
   971	          turnSourceAccountId: params.ctx?.turnSourceAccountId,
   972	          turnSourceThreadId: params.ctx?.turnSourceThreadId,
   973	        },
   974	        timeoutMs,
   975	        signal: params.signal,
   976	      });
   977	      const decision = result.decision;
   978	      const resolution = resolvePermittedPluginApprovalResolution(decision, allowedDecisions);
   979	      notifyPluginApprovalResolution(approval, resolution);
   980	      if (
   981	        resolution === PluginApprovalResolutions.ALLOW_ONCE ||
   982	        resolution === PluginApprovalResolutions.ALLOW_ALWAYS
   983	      ) {
   984	        return {
   985	          blocked: false,
   986	          params: mergeParamsWithApprovalOverrides(params.baseParams, params.overrideParams),
   987	          approvalResolution: resolution,
   988	        };
   989	      }
   990	      if (resolution === PluginApprovalResolutions.DENY) {
   991	        return {
   992	          blocked: true,
   993	          kind: "failure",
   994	          disposition: "blocked",
   995	          deniedReason: "plugin-approval",
   996	          reason: "Denied by user",
   997	          params: params.baseParams,
   998	        };
   999	      }
  1000	      // Veto carries the plugin-supplied reason; plain timeouts record a
  1001	      // timed_out failure disposition for the audit ledger.
  1002	      return approval.timeoutReason
  1003	        ? {
  1004	            blocked: true,
  1005	            kind: "veto",
  1006	            deniedReason: "plugin-approval",
  1007	            reason: approval.timeoutReason,
  1008	            params: params.baseParams,
  1009	          }
  1010	        : {
  1011	            blocked: true,
  1012	            kind: "failure",
  1013	            disposition: "timed_out",
  1014	            deniedReason: "plugin-approval",
  1015	            reason: "Approval timed out",
  1016	            params: params.baseParams,
  1017	          };
  1018	    }
  1019	
  1020	    gatewayApprovalPhase = "request";
  1021	    const requestResult: {
  1022	      id?: string;
  1023	      status?: string;
  1024	      decision?: unknown;
  1025	      deliveryRoute?: string;
  1026	    } = await callGatewayTool(
  1027	      "plugin.approval.request",
  1028	      // Buffer beyond the approval timeout so the gateway can clean up
  1029	      // and respond before the client-side RPC timeout fires.
  1030	      { timeoutMs: gatewayTimeoutMs },
  1031	      {
  1032	        pluginId: approval.pluginId,
  1033	        title: approval.title,
  1034	        description: approval.description,
  1035	        severity: approval.severity,
  1036	        allowedDecisions: approval.allowedDecisions,
  1037	        toolName: params.toolName,
  1038	        toolCallId: params.toolCallId,
  1039	        agentId: params.ctx?.agentId,
  1040	        sessionKey: params.ctx?.sessionKey,
  1041	        ...(params.ctx?.approvalReviewerDeviceId
  1042	          ? { approvalReviewerDeviceIds: [params.ctx.approvalReviewerDeviceId] }
  1043	          : {}),
  1044	        turnSourceChannel: params.ctx?.turnSourceChannel,
  1045	        turnSourceTo: params.ctx?.turnSourceTo,
  1046	        turnSourceAccountId: params.ctx?.turnSourceAccountId,
  1047	        turnSourceThreadId: params.ctx?.turnSourceThreadId,
  1048	        timeoutMs,
  1049	        twoPhase: true,
  1050	      },
  1051	      { expectFinal: false },
  1052	    );
  1053	    gatewayApprovalPhase = "none";
  1054	    const id = requestResult?.id;
  1055	    if (!id) {
  1056	      notifyPluginApprovalResolution(approval, PluginApprovalResolutions.CANCELLED);
  1057	      return {
  1058	        blocked: true,
  1059	        kind: "failure",
  1060	        disposition: "failed",
  1061	        deniedReason: "plugin-approval",
  1062	        reason: approval.description || "Plugin approval request failed",
  1063	        params: params.baseParams,
  1064	      };
  1065	    }

    69	  if (
    70	    connId &&
    71	    hasGatewayClientCap(params.client?.connect?.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.TOOL_EVENTS)
    72	  ) {
    73	    params.context.registerToolEventRecipient(params.runId, connId);
    74	    for (const [activeRunId, active] of params.context.chatAbortControllers) {
    75	      const sameSession = active.sessionKey === params.resolvedSessionKey;
    76	      const sameSelectedGlobalAgent =
    77	        params.resolvedSessionKey === "global" ? active.agentId === activeSessionAgentId : true;
    78	      if (activeRunId !== params.runId && sameSession && sameSelectedGlobalAgent) {
    79	        params.context.registerToolEventRecipient(activeRunId, connId);
    80	      }
    81	    }
    82	  }
    83	
    84	  const wantsDelivery = params.request.deliver === true;
    85	  const explicitThreadId = normalizeOptionalString(params.recipientThreadId);
    86	  const turnSourceChannel = normalizeOptionalString(params.recipientChannel);
    87	  const deliveryPlan = await resolveAgentDeliveryPlanWithSessionRoute({
    88	    cfg: params.cfgForAgent ?? params.cfg,
    89	    agentId: activeSessionAgentId,
    90	    currentSessionKey: params.resolvedSessionKey,
    91	    sessionEntry: params.sessionEntry,
    92	    requestedChannel: params.request.replyChannel ?? params.recipientChannel,
    93	    explicitTo: params.replyTo || params.to || undefined,
    94	    explicitThreadId,
    95	    accountId: params.request.replyAccountId ?? params.recipientAccountId,
    96	    wantsDelivery,
    97	    turnSourceChannel,
    98	    turnSourceTo: params.to || undefined,
    99	    turnSourceAccountId: normalizeOptionalString(params.recipientAccountId),
   100	    turnSourceThreadId: explicitThreadId,
   101	  });
   102	
   103	  let resolvedChannel = deliveryPlan.resolvedChannel;
   104	  let deliveryTargetMode = deliveryPlan.deliveryTargetMode;
   105	  const resolvedAccountId = deliveryPlan.resolvedAccountId;
   106	  let resolvedTo = deliveryPlan.resolvedTo;
   107	  let effectivePlan = deliveryPlan;
   108	  let deliveryDowngradeReason: string | null = null;
   109	  let deliveryTargetResolutionError: Error | undefined = deliveryPlan.targetResolutionError;
   110	
   111	  if (wantsDelivery && resolvedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   112	    try {
   113	      resolvedChannel = (
   114	        await resolveMessageChannelSelection({ cfg: params.cfgForAgent ?? params.cfg })
   115	      ).channel;
   116	      deliveryTargetMode = deliveryTargetMode ?? "implicit";
   117	      effectivePlan = {
   118	        ...deliveryPlan,
   119	        resolvedChannel,
   120	        deliveryTargetMode,
   121	        resolvedAccountId,
   122	      };
   123	    } catch (err) {
   124	      if (
   125	        !shouldDowngradeDeliveryToSessionOnly({
   126	          wantsDelivery,
   127	          bestEffortDeliver: params.bestEffortDeliver,
   128	          resolvedChannel,
   129	        })
   130	      ) {
   131	        params.respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, formatForLog(err)));
   132	        return undefined;
   133	      }
   134	      deliveryDowngradeReason = String(err);
   135	    }
   136	  }
   137	
   138	  if (wantsDelivery && deliveryTargetResolutionError) {
   139	    if (!params.bestEffortDeliver) {
   140	      params.respond(
   141	        false,
   142	        undefined,
   143	        errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, String(deliveryTargetResolutionError)),
   144	      );
   145	      return undefined;
   146	    }
   147	    deliveryDowngradeReason = String(deliveryTargetResolutionError);
   148	    resolvedChannel = INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   149	    deliveryTargetMode = undefined;
   150	    resolvedTo = undefined;
   151	    effectivePlan = { ...deliveryPlan, resolvedChannel, resolvedTo, deliveryTargetMode };
   152	  }
   153	
   154	  if (!resolvedTo && isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel)) {
   155	    const fallback = resolveAgentOutboundTarget({
   156	      cfg: params.cfgForAgent ?? params.cfg,
   157	      plan: effectivePlan,
   158	      targetMode: deliveryTargetMode ?? "implicit",
   159	      validateExplicitTarget: false,
   160	    });
   161	    if (fallback.resolvedTarget?.ok) {
   162	      resolvedTo = fallback.resolvedTo;
   163	    } else if (fallback.resolvedTarget && !fallback.resolvedTarget.ok) {
   164	      deliveryTargetResolutionError = fallback.resolvedTarget.error;
   165	    }
   166	  }
   167	
   168	  if (wantsDelivery && isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel) && !resolvedTo) {
   169	    if (!params.bestEffortDeliver) {
   170	      params.respond(
   171	        false,
   172	        undefined,
   173	        errorShape(
   174	          ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST,
   175	          deliveryTargetResolutionError

   177	            : `delivery target is required for ${resolvedChannel}: pass --to/--reply-to or configure a default target`,
   178	        ),
   179	      );
   180	      return undefined;
   181	    }
   182	    params.context.logGateway.info(
   183	      deliveryTargetResolutionError
   184	        ? `agent delivery target missing (bestEffortDeliver): ${String(deliveryTargetResolutionError)}`
   185	        : "agent delivery target missing (bestEffortDeliver): no deliverable target",
   186	    );
   187	  }
   188	
   189	  if (wantsDelivery && resolvedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   190	    if (
   191	      !shouldDowngradeDeliveryToSessionOnly({
   192	        wantsDelivery,
   193	        bestEffortDeliver: params.bestEffortDeliver,
   194	        resolvedChannel,
   195	      })
   196	    ) {
   197	      params.respond(
   198	        false,
   199	        undefined,
   200	        errorShape(
   201	          ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST,
   202	          "delivery channel is required: pass --channel/--reply-channel or use a main session with a previous channel",
   203	        ),
   204	      );
   205	      return undefined;
   206	    }
   207	    params.context.logGateway.info(
   208	      deliveryDowngradeReason
   209	        ? `agent delivery downgraded to session-only (bestEffortDeliver): ${deliveryDowngradeReason}`
   210	        : "agent delivery downgraded to session-only (bestEffortDeliver): no deliverable channel",
   211	    );
   212	  }
   213	
   214	  const normalizedTurnSource = normalizeMessageChannel(turnSourceChannel);
   215	  const turnSourceMessageChannel =
   216	    normalizedTurnSource &&
   217	    (isGatewayMessageChannel(normalizedTurnSource) ||
   218	      isInternalNonDeliveryChannel(normalizedTurnSource))
   219	      ? normalizedTurnSource
   220	      : undefined;
   221	  return {
   222	    activeSessionAgentId,
   223	    deliveryPlan,
   224	    resolvedChannel,
   225	    deliveryTargetMode,
   226	    resolvedAccountId,
   227	    resolvedTo,
   228	    originMessageChannel:
   229	      turnSourceMessageChannel ??
   230	      (params.client?.connect && params.isWebchatConnect(params.client.connect)
   231	        ? INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL
   232	        : resolvedChannel),
   233	    deliver: wantsDelivery && resolvedChannel !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL,
   234	    explicitThreadId,
   235	  };
   236	}

   180	      undefined,

   190	    });

   197	      params.respond(

   203	        ),
   204	      );
   205	      return undefined;
   206	    }

   214	      agentId,
   215	      respond: params.respond,
   216	    })
   217	  ) {
   218	    params.clearDedupe();
   219	    return undefined;
   220	  }
   221	  if (

   223	      ...params,
   224	      requestedSessionKeyRaw,
   225	    })
   226	  ) {
   227	    return undefined;
   228	  }

   233	      : requestedSessionKey;

   235	    params.reserveDedupe(preAcceptedReservedSessionKey, agentId);
   236	  }

   239	        ...(agentId ? { agentId } : {}),
   240	        clone: false,

    69	function formatAttachmentFailureForLog(err: unknown): string {
    70	  const primary = formatUncaughtError(err);
    71	  const cause = err instanceof Error ? err.cause : undefined;
    72	  if (cause === undefined) {
    73	    return primary;
    74	  }
    75	  const causeText = formatUncaughtError(cause);
    76	  return !causeText || causeText === primary ? primary : `${primary}\nCaused by: ${causeText}`;
    77	}
    78	
    79	function logAttachmentFailure(
    80	  logGateway: Pick<GatewayRequestHandlerOptions["context"]["logGateway"], "error">,
    81	  label: string,
    82	  err: unknown,
    83	): void {
    84	  logGateway.error(label, {
    85	    error: formatAttachmentFailureForLog(err),
    86	    consoleMessage: `${label}: ${formatForLog(err)}`,
    87	  });
    88	}

    30	// Origin updates merge sparse channel metadata without deleting previously known fields.
    31	const mergeOrigin = (
    32	  existing: SessionOrigin | undefined,
    33	  next: SessionOrigin | undefined,
    34	): SessionOrigin | undefined => {
    35	  if (!existing && !next) {
    36	    return undefined;
    37	  }
    38	  const merged: SessionOrigin = existing ? { ...existing } : {};
    39	  // A provider/surface/account change is a fresh channel identity (e.g. a dmScope:"main" session
    40	  // moving Slack -> Telegram, or between Slack accounts). Channel-keyed fields belong to the prior
    41	  // channel; drop them so an inbound that omits them does not keep reactions, native threading, and
    42	  // status reads pointed at the previous channel.
    43	  const nextProvider = next?.provider;
    44	  const nextIsDeliverableChannel =
    45	    nextProvider != null &&
    46	    nextProvider !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL &&
    47	    !isInternalNonDeliveryChannel(nextProvider) &&
    48	    !isSystemEventProvider(nextProvider);
    49	  const channelChanged =
    50	    existing != null &&
    51	    nextIsDeliverableChannel &&
    52	    ((existing.provider != null && nextProvider !== existing.provider) ||
    53	      (existing.surface != null && next?.surface != null && next.surface !== existing.surface) ||
    54	      (existing.accountId != null &&
    55	        next?.accountId != null &&
    56	        next.accountId !== existing.accountId));
    57	  if (channelChanged) {
    58	    delete merged.nativeChannelId;
    59	    delete merged.nativeDirectUserId;
    60	    delete merged.accountId;
    61	    delete merged.threadId;
    62	  }
    63	  if (next?.label) {
    64	    merged.label = next.label;
    65	  }
    66	  if (next?.provider) {
    67	    merged.provider = next.provider;
    68	  }
    69	  if (next?.surface) {
    70	    merged.surface = next.surface;
    71	  }
    72	  if (next?.chatType) {
    73	    merged.chatType = next.chatType;
    74	  }
    75	  if (next?.from) {
    76	    merged.from = next.from;
    77	  }
    78	  if (next?.to) {
    79	    merged.to = next.to;
    80	  }
    81	  if (next?.nativeChannelId) {

    83	  }

   231	      : {}),
   232	    ...(effectiveDeliveryFields.lastTo ? { lastTo: effectiveDeliveryFields.lastTo } : {}),
   233	    ...(effectiveDeliveryFields.lastAccountId
   234	      ? { lastAccountId: effectiveDeliveryFields.lastAccountId }
   235	      : {}),
   236	    ...(effectiveDeliveryFields.lastThreadId != null
   237	      ? { lastThreadId: effectiveDeliveryFields.lastThreadId }
   238	      : {}),
   239	    ...(labelValue ? { label: labelValue } : {}),
   240	    ...(freshSpawnedBy ? { spawnedBy: freshSpawnedBy } : {}),
   241	    ...(channelValue ? { channel: channelValue } : {}),
   242	    groupId: nextGroup.groupId,
   243	    groupChannel: nextGroup.groupChannel,
   244	    space: nextGroup.groupSpace,
   245	    // Plugin ownership is creation-only; existing sessions keep their original owner.
   246	    ...(params.freshEntry === undefined && params.pluginOwnerId
   247	      ? { pluginOwnerId: params.pluginOwnerId }
   248	      : {}),
   249	    ...(shouldClearRotatedState || shouldClearTerminalState
   250	      ? {
   251	          status: undefined,
   252	          startedAt: undefined,
   253	          endedAt: undefined,
   254	          runtimeMs: undefined,
   255	          abortedLastRun: undefined,
   256	          ...(shouldClearRotatedState ? { sessionFile: undefined } : {}),
   257	        }
   258	      : {}),
   259	  };
   260	  if (shouldClearRotatedState) {
   261	    clearAllCliSessions(patch);
   262	  }
   263	  return {
   264	    patch,
   265	    spawnedBy: freshSpawnedBy,
   266	    groupId: nextGroup.groupId,
   267	    groupChannel: nextGroup.groupChannel,
   268	    groupSpace: nextGroup.groupSpace,
   269	    freshSessionRotatedSinceLoad,
   270	    isNewSession: freshIsNewSession,
   140	}
   141	
   142	/** Reconciles legacy session delivery fields, route metadata, and explicit delivery context. */
   143	export function normalizeSessionDeliveryFields(source?: DeliveryContextSessionSource): {
   144	  route?: ChannelRouteRef;
   145	  deliveryContext?: DeliveryContext;
   146	  lastChannel?: string;
   147	  lastTo?: string;
   148	  lastAccountId?: string;
   149	  lastThreadId?: string | number;
   150	} {
   151	  if (!source) {
   152	    return {
   153	      route: undefined,
   154	      deliveryContext: undefined,
   155	      lastChannel: undefined,
   156	      lastTo: undefined,
   157	      lastAccountId: undefined,
   158	      lastThreadId: undefined,
   159	    };
   160	  }
   161	
   162	  const normalizedRoute = normalizeDeliveryChannelRoute(source.route);
   163	  const routeContext = deliveryContextFromChannelRoute(normalizedRoute);
   164	  const legacyContext = normalizeDeliveryContext({
   165	    channel: source.lastChannel ?? source.channel,
   166	    to: source.lastTo,
   167	    accountId: source.lastAccountId,
   168	    threadId: source.lastThreadId,
   169	  });
   170	  const deliveryContext = normalizeDeliveryContext(source.deliveryContext);
   171	  // Legacy webchat `last*` fields can outlive the external channel that should
   172	  // receive replies. Prefer an explicit deliverable context when it exists.
   173	  const sessionContext =
   174	    isInternalRouteContext(legacyContext) && hasExternalDeliveryTarget(deliveryContext)
   175	      ? mergeExternalDeliveryContextOverInternalRoute(deliveryContext, legacyContext)
   176	      : mergeDeliveryContext(legacyContext, deliveryContext);
   177	  const routeInternalContext = mergeDeliveryContext(routeContext, legacyContext);
   178	  // Route metadata normally wins, except for internal fallback routes paired
   179	  // with an explicit external delivery target from newer session state.
   180	  const routeIsInternalFallback =
   181	    isInternalRouteContext(routeContext) && hasExternalDeliveryTarget(deliveryContext);
   182	  const merged = routeIsInternalFallback
   183	    ? mergeExternalDeliveryContextOverInternalRoute(deliveryContext, routeInternalContext)
   184	    : mergeDeliveryContext(routeContext, sessionContext);
   185	
   186	  if (!merged) {
   187	    return {
   188	      route: undefined,
   189	      deliveryContext: undefined,
   190	      lastChannel: undefined,
   191	      lastTo: undefined,
   192	      lastAccountId: undefined,
   193	      lastThreadId: undefined,
   194	    };
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  return {
   198	    route: mergeRouteMetadataWithDeliveryContext(
   199	      routeIsInternalFallback ? undefined : normalizedRoute,
   200	      merged,
   201	    ),
   202	    deliveryContext: merged,
   203	    lastChannel: merged.channel,
   204	    lastTo: merged.to,
   205	    lastAccountId: merged.accountId,
   206	    lastThreadId: merged.threadId,
   207	  };
   208	}
   209	
   210	/** Derives the best delivery context from current and legacy session fields. */
   211	export function deliveryContextFromSession(
   212	  entry?: DeliveryContextSessionSource,
   213	): DeliveryContext | undefined {
   214	  if (!entry) {
   215	    return undefined;
   216	  }
   217	  const source: DeliveryContextSessionSource = {
   218	    route: entry.route,
   219	    channel: entry.channel ?? entry.origin?.provider,
   220	    lastChannel: entry.lastChannel,
   221	    lastTo: entry.lastTo,
   222	    lastAccountId: entry.lastAccountId ?? entry.origin?.accountId,
   223	    lastThreadId: entry.lastThreadId ?? entry.deliveryContext?.threadId ?? entry.origin?.threadId,
   224	    origin: entry.origin,
   225	    deliveryContext: entry.deliveryContext,
   226	  };
   227	  return normalizeSessionDeliveryFields(source).deliveryContext;
   228	}

    48	function resolveScopedMethod(method: string): OperatorScope | undefined {
    49	  // Core descriptors are authoritative, then reserved namespace policy, then active plugin
    50	  // descriptors. Node/dynamic sentinels are intentionally excluded from operator scopes.
    51	  const explicitScope = resolveCoreOperatorGatewayMethodScope(method);
    52	  if (explicitScope) {
    53	    return explicitScope;
    54	  }
    55	  const reservedScope = resolveReservedGatewayMethodScope(method);
    56	  if (reservedScope) {
    57	    return reservedScope;
    58	  }
    59	  const pluginDescriptor = getPluginRegistryState()?.activeRegistry?.gatewayMethodDescriptors?.find(
    60	    (descriptor) => descriptor.name === method,
    61	  );
    62	  const pluginScope = pluginDescriptor?.scope;
    63	  return pluginScope === "node" || pluginScope === "dynamic" ? undefined : pluginScope;
    64	}

    18	/**
    19	 * Projects a channel approval capability into the runtime approval adapter shape.
    20	 */
    21	export function resolveChannelApprovalAdapter(
    22	  plugin?: Pick<ChannelPlugin, "approvalCapability"> | null,
    23	): ChannelApprovalAdapter | undefined {
    24	  const capability = resolveChannelApprovalCapability(plugin);
    25	  if (!capability) {
    26	    return undefined;
    27	  }
    28	  if (
    29	    !capability.delivery &&
    30	    !capability.nativeRuntime &&
    31	    !capability.render &&
    32	    !capability.native
    33	  ) {
    34	    // Auth-only capabilities are valid plugin metadata but do not form a delivery adapter.
    35	    return undefined;
    36	  }
    37	  return {
    38	    describeExecApprovalSetup: capability.describeExecApprovalSetup,
    39	    describePluginApprovalSetup: capability.describePluginApprovalSetup,
    40	    delivery: capability.delivery,
    41	    nativeRuntime: capability.nativeRuntime,
    42	    render: capability.render,
    43	    native: capability.native,
    44	  };
    45	}

    23	function isRetryableApprovalBootstrapStartError(error: unknown): boolean {
    24	  const message = String(error);
    25	  return (
    26	    message.includes("gateway readiness unavailable before approval client start") ||
    27	    message.includes("gateway approval client start aborted before readiness") ||
    28	    message.includes("gateway readiness unavailable before exec approval runtime start") ||
    29	    message.includes("gateway approval runtime start aborted before readiness") ||
    30	    message.includes("gateway event loop readiness timeout") ||
    31	    message.includes("gateway starting") ||
    32	    message.includes("code=1013") ||
    33	    message.includes("close code 1013")
    34	  );
    35	}
    36	
    37	function formatRetryableApprovalBootstrapStartError(error: unknown): string {
    38	  const message = String(error);
    39	  if (message.includes("gateway event loop readiness timeout")) {
    40	    return "gateway readiness unavailable before approval handler start";
    41	  }
    42	  return message;
    43	}

    45	/** Starts the native approval handler for a channel runtime context and returns its cleanup hook. */
    46	export async function startChannelApprovalHandlerBootstrap(params: {
    47	  plugin: Pick<ChannelPlugin, "id" | "meta" | "approvalCapability">;
    48	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
    49	  accountId: string;
    50	  channelRuntime?: ChannelRuntimeSurface;
    51	  gatewayRuntime?: GatewayNativeApprovalRuntime;
    52	  logger?: ReturnType<typeof createSubsystemLogger>;
    53	}): Promise<() => Promise<void>> {
    54	  const capability = resolveChannelApprovalCapability(params.plugin);
    55	  if (!capability?.nativeRuntime || !params.channelRuntime) {
    56	    return async () => {};
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  const channelLabel = params.plugin.meta.label || params.plugin.id;
    60	  const logger = params.logger ?? createSubsystemLogger(`${params.plugin.id}/approval-bootstrap`);
    61	  let activeGeneration = 0;
    62	  let activeHandler: ApprovalBootstrapHandler | null = null;
    63	  let retryTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    64	  const invalidateActiveHandler = () => {
    65	    activeGeneration += 1;
    66	  };
    67	  const clearRetryTimer = () => {
    68	    if (!retryTimer) {
    69	      return;
    70	    }
    71	    clearTimeout(retryTimer);
    72	    retryTimer = null;
    73	  };
    74	
    75	  const stopHandler = async () => {
    76	    const handler = activeHandler;
    77	    activeHandler = null;
    78	    if (!handler) {
    79	      return;
    80	    }
    81	    await handler.stop();
    82	  };
    83	
    84	  const startHandlerForContext = async (context: unknown, generation: number) => {
    85	    if (generation !== activeGeneration) {
    86	      return;
    87	    }
    88	    await stopHandler();
    89	    if (generation !== activeGeneration) {
    90	      return;
    91	    }
    92	    const handler = await withGatewayNativeApprovalRuntime(params.gatewayRuntime, () =>
    93	      createChannelApprovalHandlerFromCapability({
    94	        capability,
    95	        label: `${params.plugin.id}/native-approvals`,
    96	        clientDisplayName: `${channelLabel} Native Approvals (${params.accountId})`,
    97	        channel: params.plugin.id,
    98	        channelLabel,
    99	        cfg: params.cfg,
   100	        accountId: params.accountId,
   101	        context,
   102	      }),
   103	    );
   104	    if (!handler) {
   105	      return;
   106	    }
   107	    if (generation !== activeGeneration) {
   108	      // Runtime contexts can unregister while the handler factory awaits; stop stale handlers.
   109	      await handler.stop().catch(() => {});
   110	      return;
   111	    }
   112	    activeHandler = handler as ApprovalBootstrapHandler;
   113	    try {
   114	      await withGatewayNativeApprovalRuntime(params.gatewayRuntime, () => handler.start());
   115	    } catch (error) {
   116	      if (activeHandler === handler) {
   117	        activeHandler = null;
   118	      }
   119	      await handler.stop().catch(() => {});
   120	      throw error;
   121	    }
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const spawn = (label: string, promise: Promise<void>) => {
   125	    void promise.catch((error: unknown) => {
   126	      logger.error(`${label}: ${String(error)}`);
   127	    });
   128	  };
   129	  const scheduleRetryForContext = (context: unknown, generation: number) => {
   130	    if (generation !== activeGeneration) {
   131	      return;
   132	    }
   133	    clearRetryTimer();
   134	    retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   135	      retryTimer = null;
   136	      if (generation !== activeGeneration) {
   137	        return;
   138	      }
   139	      spawn(
   140	        "failed to retry native approval handler",
   141	        startHandlerForRegisteredContext(context, generation),
   142	      );
   143	    }, APPROVAL_HANDLER_BOOTSTRAP_RETRY_MS);
   144	    retryTimer.unref?.();
   145	  };
   146	  const startHandlerForRegisteredContext = async (context: unknown, generation: number) => {
   147	    try {
   148	      await startHandlerForContext(context, generation);
   149	    } catch (error) {
   150	      if (generation === activeGeneration) {
   151	        if (isExecApprovalChannelRuntimeTerminalStartError(error)) {
   152	          logger.error(`native approval handler disabled: ${String(error)}`);
   153	          return;
   154	        }
   155	        if (isRetryableApprovalBootstrapStartError(error)) {
   156	          logger.warn(
   157	            `native approval handler deferred until gateway readiness recovers: ${formatRetryableApprovalBootstrapStartError(error)}`,
   158	          );
   159	          scheduleRetryForContext(context, generation);
   160	          return;
   161	        }
   162	        logger.error(`failed to start native approval handler: ${String(error)}`);
   163	        scheduleRetryForContext(context, generation);
   164	      }
   165	    }
   166	  };
   167	
   168	  const unsubscribe =
   169	    watchChannelRuntimeContexts({
   170	      channelRuntime: params.channelRuntime,
   171	      channelId: params.plugin.id,
   172	      accountId: params.accountId,
   173	      capability: CHANNEL_APPROVAL_NATIVE_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY,
   174	      onEvent: (event) => {
   175	        if (event.type === "registered") {
   176	          clearRetryTimer();
   177	          invalidateActiveHandler();
   178	          const generation = activeGeneration;
   179	          spawn(
   180	            "failed to start native approval handler",

   101	function createPendingApprovalRouteNotice(
   102	  state: ApprovalNativeRouteCoordinatorState,
   103	  params: {
   104	    request: ApprovalRequest;
   105	    approvalKind: ChannelApprovalKind;
   106	    expectedRuntimeIds?: Iterable<string>;
   107	  },
   108	): PendingApprovalRouteNotice {
   109	  const timeoutMs = Math.min(
   110	    Math.max(0, params.request.expiresAtMs - Date.now()),
   111	    MAX_APPROVAL_ROUTE_NOTICE_TTL_MS,
   112	  );
   113	  const cleanupTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   114	    clearPendingApprovalRouteNotice(state, params.request.id);
   115	  }, timeoutMs);
   116	  cleanupTimeout.unref?.();
   117	  return {
   118	    request: params.request,
   119	    approvalKind: params.approvalKind,
   120	    // Snapshot siblings at first observation time so already-running runtimes
   121	    // can still aggregate one notice, while late-starting runtimes that cannot
   122	    // replay old gateway events never block the quorum.
   123	    expectedRuntimeIds: new Set(params.expectedRuntimeIds ?? []),
   124	    reports: new Map(),
   125	    cleanupTimeout,
   126	    finalized: false,
   127	  };
   128	}

   130	function resolveRouteNoticeTargetFromRequest(request: ApprovalRequest): RouteNoticeTarget | null {
   131	  const channel = request.request.turnSourceChannel?.trim();
   132	  const to = request.request.turnSourceTo?.trim();
   133	  if (!channel || !to) {
   134	    return null;
   135	  }
   136	  return {
   137	    channel,
   138	    to,
   139	    accountId: request.request.turnSourceAccountId ?? undefined,
   140	    threadId: request.request.turnSourceThreadId ?? undefined,
   141	  };
   142	}

   156	}

   158	function didReportDeliverToOrigin(report: ApprovalRouteReport, originAccountId?: string): boolean {
   159	  const originTarget = report.deliveryPlan.originTarget;
   160	  if (!originTarget) {
   161	    return false;
   162	  }
   163	  const reportAccountId = normalizeOptionalString(report.accountId);
   164	  if (
   165	    originAccountId !== undefined &&
   166	    reportAccountId !== undefined &&
   167	    reportAccountId !== originAccountId
   168	  ) {
   169	    return false;
   170	  }
   171	  const originKey = buildChannelApprovalNativeTargetKey(originTarget);
   172	  return report.deliveredTargets.some(
   173	    (plannedTarget) => buildChannelApprovalNativeTargetKey(plannedTarget.target) === originKey,
   174	  );
   175	}

   177	function hasPlannedNativeTargets(report: ApprovalRouteReport): boolean {
   178	  return report.deliveryPlan.targets.length > 0;
   179	}

   182	  const allowedDecisions =
   183	    "allowedDecisions" in request.request ? request.request.allowedDecisions : undefined;
   184	  if (!Array.isArray(allowedDecisions)) {
   185	    return undefined;
   186	  }
   187	  return allowedDecisions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string");
   188	}

    63	function resolveAgentDeliveryPlan(params: {
    64	  sessionEntry?: SessionEntry;
    65	  requestedChannel?: string;
    66	  explicitTo?: string;
    67	  explicitThreadId?: string | number;
    68	  accountId?: string;
    69	  wantsDelivery: boolean;
    70	  /**
    71	   * The channel that originated the current agent turn.  When provided,
    72	   * overrides session-level `lastChannel` to prevent cross-channel reply
    73	   * routing in shared sessions (dmScope="main").
    74	   *
    75	   * @see https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/24152
    76	   */
    77	  turnSourceChannel?: string;
    78	  /** Turn-source `to` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    79	  turnSourceTo?: string;
    80	  /** Turn-source `accountId` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    81	  turnSourceAccountId?: string;
    82	  /** Turn-source `threadId` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    83	  turnSourceThreadId?: string | number;
    84	}): AgentDeliveryPlan {
    85	  const requestedRaw = normalizeOptionalString(params.requestedChannel) ?? "";
    86	  const normalizedRequested = requestedRaw ? normalizeMessageChannel(requestedRaw) : undefined;
    87	  const requestedChannel = normalizedRequested || "last";
    88	
    89	  const explicitTo = normalizeOptionalString(params.explicitTo) ?? undefined;
    90	
    91	  // Resolve turn-source channel for cross-channel safety.
    92	  const normalizedTurnSource = params.turnSourceChannel
    93	    ? normalizeMessageChannel(params.turnSourceChannel)
    94	    : undefined;
    95	  const turnSourceChannel =
    96	    normalizedTurnSource && isDeliverableMessageChannel(normalizedTurnSource)
    97	      ? normalizedTurnSource
    98	      : undefined;
    99	  const turnSourceTo = normalizeOptionalString(params.turnSourceTo) ?? undefined;
   100	  const turnSourceAccountId = normalizeAccountId(params.turnSourceAccountId);
   101	  const turnSourceThreadId =
   102	    params.turnSourceThreadId != null && params.turnSourceThreadId !== ""
   103	      ? params.turnSourceThreadId
   104	      : undefined;
   105	
   106	  const baseDelivery = resolveSessionDeliveryTarget({
   107	    entry: params.sessionEntry,
   108	    requestedChannel: requestedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL ? "last" : requestedChannel,
   109	    explicitTo,
   110	    explicitThreadId: params.explicitThreadId,
   111	    turnSourceChannel,
   112	    turnSourceTo,
   113	    turnSourceAccountId,
   114	    turnSourceThreadId,
   115	  });
   116	
   117	  const resolvedChannel = (() => {
   118	    if (requestedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   119	      return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   120	    }
   121	    if (requestedChannel === "last") {
   122	      if (baseDelivery.channel && baseDelivery.channel !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   123	        return baseDelivery.channel;
   124	      }
   125	      return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   126	    }
   127	
   128	    if (isGatewayMessageChannel(requestedChannel)) {
   129	      return requestedChannel;
   130	    }
   131	
   132	    if (baseDelivery.channel && baseDelivery.channel !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   133	      return baseDelivery.channel;
   134	    }
   135	    return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   136	  })();
   137	
   138	  const deliveryTargetMode = explicitTo
   139	    ? "explicit"
   140	    : isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel)
   141	      ? "implicit"
   142	      : undefined;
   143	
   144	  const resolvedAccountId =
   145	    normalizeAccountId(params.accountId) ??
   146	    (deliveryTargetMode === "implicit" ? baseDelivery.accountId : undefined);
   147	
   148	  let resolvedTo = explicitTo;
   149	  if (
   150	    !resolvedTo &&
   151	    isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel) &&
   152	    resolvedChannel === baseDelivery.lastChannel
   153	  ) {
   154	    resolvedTo = baseDelivery.lastTo;
   155	  }
   156	
   157	  return {
   158	    baseDelivery,
   159	    resolvedChannel,
   160	    resolvedTo,
   161	    resolvedAccountId,
   162	    resolvedThreadId: baseDelivery.threadId,
   163	    deliveryTargetMode,
   164	  };
   165	}

    36	  return listGatewayMessageChannels().includes(value as GatewayMessageChannel);
    37	}
    38	
    39	/** Returns whether a normalized id is a deliverable non-internal channel. */
    40	export function isDeliverableMessageChannel(value: string): value is DeliverableMessageChannel {
    41	  return listDeliverableMessageChannels().includes(value as DeliverableMessageChannel);
    42	}
    43	
    44	/** Normalizes and validates a raw channel value for Gateway routing. */
    45	export function resolveGatewayMessageChannel(
    46	  raw?: string | null,
    47	): GatewayMessageChannel | undefined {
    48	  const normalized = normalizeMessageChannel(raw);
    49	  if (!normalized) {
    50	    return undefined;
    51	  }
    52	  return isGatewayMessageChannel(normalized) ? normalized : undefined;
    53	}

   116	function canDeliverApprovals(
   117	  gatewayClient: GatewayRequestContextClient,
   118	  approvalKind: "exec" | "plugin" | "system-agent",
   119	): boolean {
   120	  if (gatewayClient.invalidated) {

   122	  }
   123	  const scopes = Array.isArray(gatewayClient.connect.scopes) ? gatewayClient.connect.scopes : [];
   124	  const hasApprovalScope =
   125	    scopes.includes("operator.admin") || scopes.includes("operator.approvals");
   126	  if (!hasApprovalScope) {
   127	    return false;
   128	  }
   129	  // Scope grants approval access; it does not prove the client renders this approval kind.
   130	  // Stable ids preserve shipped clients while explicit caps describe newer non-UI bridges.
   131	  return (
   132	    gatewayClient.internal?.approvalRuntime === true ||
   133	    ALL_APPROVAL_CLIENT_IDS.has(gatewayClient.connect.client.id) ||
   134	    hasGatewayClientCap(gatewayClient.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.APPROVALS) ||
   135	    (approvalKind === "exec" &&

   137	        hasGatewayClientCap(gatewayClient.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.EXEC_APPROVALS))) ||
   138	    (approvalKind === "plugin" &&

    24	/** Whether a client may inspect safe approval projections. */
    25	export function canReviewOperatorApproval(client: GatewayClient | null): boolean {
    26	  const scopes = Array.isArray(client?.connect?.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
    27	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
    28	    return true;
    29	  }
    30	  if (!scopes.includes(APPROVALS_SCOPE)) {
    31	    return false;
    32	  }
    33	  return Boolean(normalizeOptionalString(client?.connect?.device?.id));
    34	}
    35	
    36	/** Whether a client may submit an approval verdict. */
    37	export function canResolveOperatorApproval(client: GatewayClient | null): boolean {
    38	  // approvalRuntime is server-authenticated connection metadata. Public request
    39	  // fields cannot mint this device-less resolver authority.
    40	  const scopes = Array.isArray(client?.connect?.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
    41	  const isTrustedApprovalRuntime =
    42	    client?.internal?.approvalRuntime === true && scopes.includes(APPROVALS_SCOPE);
    43	  return isTrustedApprovalRuntime || canReviewOperatorApproval(client);
    44	}
    45	
    46	/** Whether a broadly authorized client may access one bound approval record. */
    47	export function canAccessOperatorApproval(params: {
    48	  client: GatewayClient | null;
    49	  binding: OperatorApprovalAccessBinding;
    50	  allowApprovalRuntime?: boolean;
    51	}): boolean {
    52	  const broadlyAuthorized = params.allowApprovalRuntime
    53	    ? canResolveOperatorApproval(params.client)
    54	    : canReviewOperatorApproval(params.client);
    55	  if (!broadlyAuthorized) {
    56	    return false;
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  const scopes = Array.isArray(params.client?.connect?.scopes) ? params.client.connect.scopes : [];
    60	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
    61	    return true;
    62	  }
    63	  if (params.allowApprovalRuntime && params.client?.internal?.approvalRuntime === true) {
    64	    return true;
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  const clientDeviceId = normalizeIdentity(params.client?.connect?.device?.id);
    68	  const reviewerDeviceIds = normalizeIdentities(params.binding.reviewerDeviceIds);
    69	  if (reviewerDeviceIds.length > 0) {
    70	    return Boolean(clientDeviceId && reviewerDeviceIds.includes(clientDeviceId));
    71	  }
    72	
    73	  // No explicit reviewer binding: the operator.approvals scope tier is the
    74	  // access authority, matching the shipped contract where any authorized
    75	  // approval surface (Telegram buttons, macOS app, control UI) may resolve
    76	  // any pending approval. Cross-surface first-answer-wins depends on this;
    77	  // reviewerDeviceIds is the opt-in restriction, and requester identity gates
    78	  // only the legacy adapters in approval-shared.
    79	  return true;
    80	}

   225	export function normalizeSessionKeyPreservingOpaquePeerIds(
   226	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   227	): string {
   228	  const raw = normalizeOptionalString(sessionKey);
   229	  if (!raw) {
   230	    return "";
   231	  }
   232	  const cached = readNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw);
   233	  if (cached !== undefined) {
   234	    return cached;
   235	  }
   236	  if (!mayContainCasePreservingPeer(raw)) {
   237	    const normalized = raw.toLowerCase();
   238	    writeNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw, normalized);
   239	    return normalized;
   240	  }
   241	  const spans = collectCasePreservedSpans(raw)
   242	    .filter((span) => span.end > span.start)
   243	    .toSorted((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
   244	
   245	  let normalized = "";
   246	  let cursor = 0;
   247	  for (const span of spans) {
   248	    if (span.start < cursor) {
   249	      // Overlapping/contained in an already-emitted preserved range; skip.
   250	      continue;
   251	    }
   252	    normalized += normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw.slice(cursor, span.start));
   253	    const preserved = raw.slice(span.start, span.end);
   254	    normalized += span.trim ? preserved.trim() : preserved;
   255	    cursor = span.end;
   256	  }
   257	  normalized += normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw.slice(cursor));
   258	  writeNormalizedSessionKeyCache(raw, normalized);
   259	  return normalized;
   260	}

   262	/**
   263	 * Parse agent-scoped session keys in a canonical, case-insensitive way.
   264	 * Returned values are canonicalized for stable comparisons/routing while
   265	 * preserving provider-owned opaque peer IDs.
   266	 */
   267	export function parseAgentSessionKey(
   268	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   269	): ParsedAgentSessionKey | null {
   270	  const raw = normalizeSessionKeyPreservingOpaquePeerIds(sessionKey);
   271	  if (!raw) {
   272	    return null;
   273	  }
   274	  const parts = raw.split(":");
   275	  if (parts.length < 3 || !parts[1] || !parts[2]) {
   276	    return null;
   277	  }
   278	  if (parts[0] !== "agent") {
   279	    return null;
   280	  }
   281	  const agentId = normalizeOptionalString(parts[1]);
   282	  const rest = parts.slice(2).join(":");
   283	  if (!agentId || !rest) {
   284	    return null;
   285	  }
   286	  return { agentId, rest };
   287	}

   396	/** Parse only complete external delivery shapes; nested ownership stays opaque. */
   397	export function parseSessionDeliveryRoute(
   398	  sessionKey: string | undefined | null,
   399	): ParsedSessionDeliveryRoute | null {

   403	    return null;
   404	  }
   405	  const parts = parsed.rest.split(":");

   407	    return null;
   408	  }

   410	  if (!channel) {

   434	    return null;
   435	  }
   436	  return { channel, peerId, peerKind, threadId: parsedThread.threadId };
   437	}

   109	export function toAgentStoreSessionKey(params: {

   135	export function classifySessionKeyShape(sessionKey: string | undefined | null): SessionKeyShape {
   136	  const raw = (sessionKey ?? "").trim();
   137	  if (!raw) {
   138	    return "missing";
   139	  }
   140	  if (parseAgentSessionKey(raw)) {
   141	    return "agent";
   142	  }
   143	  return normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(raw).startsWith("agent:")
   144	    ? "malformed_agent"
   145	    : "legacy_or_alias";
   146	}

   176	}

    42	function rebaseOutboundSessionRoute(
    43	  route: OutboundSessionRoute,
    44	  baseSessionKey: string,
    45	): OutboundSessionRoute | null {
    46	  if (route.baseSessionKey === baseSessionKey) {
    47	    return route;
    48	  }
    49	  if (route.sessionKey === route.baseSessionKey) {
    50	    return { ...route, sessionKey: baseSessionKey, baseSessionKey };
    51	  }
    52	  const basePrefix = `${route.baseSessionKey}:`;
    53	  if (!route.sessionKey.startsWith(basePrefix)) {
    54	    return null;
    55	  }
    56	  return {
    57	    ...route,
    58	    sessionKey: `${baseSessionKey}:${route.sessionKey.slice(basePrefix.length)}`,
    59	    baseSessionKey,
    60	  };
    61	}

    63	function resolveAgentDeliveryPlan(params: {
    64	  sessionEntry?: SessionEntry;
    65	  requestedChannel?: string;
    66	  explicitTo?: string;
    67	  explicitThreadId?: string | number;
    68	  accountId?: string;
    69	  wantsDelivery: boolean;
    70	  /**
    71	   * The channel that originated the current agent turn.  When provided,
    72	   * overrides session-level `lastChannel` to prevent cross-channel reply
    73	   * routing in shared sessions (dmScope="main").
    74	   *
    75	   * @see https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/24152
    76	   */
    77	  turnSourceChannel?: string;
    78	  /** Turn-source `to` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    79	  turnSourceTo?: string;
    80	  /** Turn-source `accountId` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    81	  turnSourceAccountId?: string;
    82	  /** Turn-source `threadId` — paired with `turnSourceChannel`. */
    83	  turnSourceThreadId?: string | number;
    84	}): AgentDeliveryPlan {
    85	  const requestedRaw = normalizeOptionalString(params.requestedChannel) ?? "";
    86	  const normalizedRequested = requestedRaw ? normalizeMessageChannel(requestedRaw) : undefined;
    87	  const requestedChannel = normalizedRequested || "last";
    88	
    89	  const explicitTo = normalizeOptionalString(params.explicitTo) ?? undefined;
    90	
    91	  // Resolve turn-source channel for cross-channel safety.
    92	  const normalizedTurnSource = params.turnSourceChannel
    93	    ? normalizeMessageChannel(params.turnSourceChannel)
    94	    : undefined;
    95	  const turnSourceChannel =
    96	    normalizedTurnSource && isDeliverableMessageChannel(normalizedTurnSource)
    97	      ? normalizedTurnSource
    98	      : undefined;
    99	  const turnSourceTo = normalizeOptionalString(params.turnSourceTo) ?? undefined;
   100	  const turnSourceAccountId = normalizeAccountId(params.turnSourceAccountId);
   101	  const turnSourceThreadId =
   102	    params.turnSourceThreadId != null && params.turnSourceThreadId !== ""
   103	      ? params.turnSourceThreadId
   104	      : undefined;
   105	
   106	  const baseDelivery = resolveSessionDeliveryTarget({
   107	    entry: params.sessionEntry,
   108	    requestedChannel: requestedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL ? "last" : requestedChannel,
   109	    explicitTo,
   110	    explicitThreadId: params.explicitThreadId,
   111	    turnSourceChannel,
   112	    turnSourceTo,
   113	    turnSourceAccountId,
   114	    turnSourceThreadId,
   115	  });
   116	
   117	  const resolvedChannel = (() => {
   118	    if (requestedChannel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   119	      return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   120	    }
   121	    if (requestedChannel === "last") {
   122	      if (baseDelivery.channel && baseDelivery.channel !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   123	        return baseDelivery.channel;
   124	      }
   125	      return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   126	    }
   127	
   128	    if (isGatewayMessageChannel(requestedChannel)) {
   129	      return requestedChannel;
   130	    }
   131	
   132	    if (baseDelivery.channel && baseDelivery.channel !== INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
   133	      return baseDelivery.channel;
   134	    }
   135	    return INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL;
   136	  })();
   137	
   138	  const deliveryTargetMode = explicitTo
   139	    ? "explicit"
   140	    : isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel)
   141	      ? "implicit"
   142	      : undefined;
   143	
   144	  const resolvedAccountId =
   145	    normalizeAccountId(params.accountId) ??
   146	    (deliveryTargetMode === "implicit" ? baseDelivery.accountId : undefined);
   147	
   148	  let resolvedTo = explicitTo;
   149	  if (
   150	    !resolvedTo &&
   151	    isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel) &&
   152	    resolvedChannel === baseDelivery.lastChannel
   153	  ) {
   154	    resolvedTo = baseDelivery.lastTo;
   155	  }
   156	
   157	  return {
   158	    baseDelivery,
   159	    resolvedChannel,
   160	    resolvedTo,
   161	    resolvedAccountId,
   162	    resolvedThreadId: baseDelivery.threadId,
   163	    deliveryTargetMode,
   164	  };
   165	}

   167	export async function resolveAgentDeliveryPlanWithSessionRoute(
   168	  params: Parameters<typeof resolveAgentDeliveryPlan>[0] & {
   169	    cfg: OpenClawConfig;
   170	    agentId: string;
   171	    currentSessionKey?: string;
   172	    sessionRouteMode?: "plugin-only" | "allow-fallback";
   173	  },
   174	): Promise<AgentDeliveryPlan> {
   175	  const plan = resolveAgentDeliveryPlan(params);
   176	  const { resolvedChannel } = plan;
   177	  if (!params.wantsDelivery || !isDeliverableMessageChannel(resolvedChannel)) {
   178	    return plan;
   179	  }
   180	  const plugin = resolveOutboundChannelPlugin({
   181	    channel: resolvedChannel,
   182	    cfg: params.cfg,
   183	    allowBootstrap: true,
   184	  });
   185	  if (!plugin) {
   186	    return plan;
   187	  }
   188	  const hasPluginSessionRoute = Boolean(plugin?.messaging?.resolveOutboundSessionRoute);
   189	  const hasPluginTargetResolver = Boolean(plugin?.messaging?.targetResolver);
   190	  // Only concrete plugin resolution makes a directory miss authoritative.
   191	  // Heuristic-only resolvers preserve the shipped normalized fallback.
   192	  const hasPluginConcreteTargetResolver = Boolean(plugin?.messaging?.targetResolver?.resolveTarget);
   193	  if (
   194	    !hasPluginSessionRoute &&
   195	    !hasPluginTargetResolver &&
   196	    params.sessionRouteMode !== "allow-fallback"
   197	  ) {
   198	    return plan;
   199	  }
   200	  const resolvedAccountId =
   201	    plan.resolvedAccountId ??
   202	    (params.sessionRouteMode === "allow-fallback"
   203	      ? resolveChannelDefaultAccountId({ plugin, cfg: params.cfg })
   204	      : undefined);
   205	  const routedPlan =
   206	    resolvedAccountId === plan.resolvedAccountId ? plan : { ...plan, resolvedAccountId };
   207	  const normalizedTarget = resolveOutboundTarget({
   208	    channel: resolvedChannel,
   209	    to: routedPlan.resolvedTo,
   210	    cfg: params.cfg,
   211	    accountId: routedPlan.resolvedAccountId,
   212	    mode: routedPlan.deliveryTargetMode ?? "explicit",
   213	  });
   214	  const targetInput = normalizedTarget.ok ? normalizedTarget.to : routedPlan.resolvedTo;
   215	  if (!targetInput) {
   216	    return normalizedTarget.ok
   217	      ? routedPlan
   218	      : { ...routedPlan, targetResolutionError: normalizedTarget.error };
   219	  }
   220	  const resolvedTarget = await resolveChannelTarget({
   221	    cfg: params.cfg,
   222	    channel: resolvedChannel as ChannelId,
   223	    input: targetInput,
   224	    accountId: routedPlan.resolvedAccountId,
   225	    unknownTargetMode: hasPluginConcreteTargetResolver ? "error" : "normalized",
   226	    plugin,
   227	  });
   228	  if (!resolvedTarget.ok) {
   229	    return { ...routedPlan, targetResolutionError: resolvedTarget.error };
   230	  }
   231	  // An async normalized fallback cannot erase an earlier synchronous validation error.
   232	  if (!normalizedTarget.ok && resolvedTarget.target.resolutionSource === "normalized") {
   233	    return { ...routedPlan, targetResolutionError: normalizedTarget.error };
   234	  }
   235	  const sessionRouteTarget = resolvedTarget.target.to;
   236	  const resolvedSessionRouteTarget: ResolvedMessagingTarget | undefined =
   237	    !normalizedTarget.ok ||
   238	    normalizedTarget.to !== resolvedTarget.target.to ||
   239	    resolvedTarget.target.resolutionSource === "directory"
   240	      ? resolvedTarget.target
   241	      : undefined;
   242	  const resolvedPlan = { ...routedPlan, resolvedTo: sessionRouteTarget };
   243	  if (!hasPluginSessionRoute && params.sessionRouteMode !== "allow-fallback") {
   244	    return resolvedPlan;
   245	  }
   246	  const explicitThreadId =
   247	    params.explicitThreadId != null && params.explicitThreadId !== ""
   248	      ? params.explicitThreadId
   249	      : undefined;
   250	  const route = await (async () => {
   251	    try {
   252	      return await resolveOutboundSessionRoute({
   253	        cfg: params.cfg,
   254	        channel: resolvedChannel as ChannelId,
   255	        plugin,
   256	        agentId: params.agentId,
   257	        accountId: routedPlan.resolvedAccountId,
   258	        target: sessionRouteTarget,
   259	        ...(resolvedSessionRouteTarget ? { resolvedTarget: resolvedSessionRouteTarget } : {}),
   260	        currentSessionKey: params.currentSessionKey,

   438	    ///   Task 何时真正跑到 `request()` 完全取决于 Swift actor 调度，`send()` 若紧随其后调用，
   439	    ///   结构上可能在订阅 RPC 连**发都没发**的情况下就把 `sessions.send` 发出去（`evidence/
   440	    ///   item2-subscribe-race.md` 承认两次真实观测都是订阅帧领先，但"结构上仍可能反过来"）。加了
   441	    ///   屏障后这一点变成确定性保证，不再依赖调度巧合。
   442	    /// - **未闭合的残余窗口**：即使客户端确定性地保证了"订阅 RPC 先 dispatch"，服务端那两个 handler
   443	    ///   仍然是并发处理、彼此不等待——`evidence/item2-subscribe-race.md` 判定的"「subscribe 帧到达」
   444	    ///   到「其 handler 抵达 dispatch」"这段窗口本身发生在**服务端**，不受客户端 dispatch 顺序影响。
   445	    ///   真正完整闭合它，需要 send() 等 ack（本设计已论证在当前 CI 契约测试模型下不可行）或服务端
   446	    ///   自己序列化处理——**两者都超出本轮范围**，如实记为已知残余风险，留给后续轮次（要么先改
   447	    ///   fixture 让它们能表达"等 ack"的场景，要么去服务端修）。
   448	    ///
   449	    /// **`stop()` 复用同一屏障**（见该方法文档注释）——两者是本轮判断"哪些方法需要等"后的结论，
   450	    /// `interrupt()`/`respondApproval()` 仍是 TODO 桩、没有任何 RPC 可 dispatch，不需要、也没有加。
   451	    public func send(session: SessionHandle, input: Input) async throws -> SendResultPayload {
   452	        await awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending(sessionID: session.sessionID)
   453	        guard let kernelKey = kernelKeyBySessionID[session.sessionID] else {
   454	            throw KernelClientError.protocolMismatch("unknown session \(session.sessionID)")
   455	        }
   456	
   457	        let currentLock = lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] ?? .idle
   458	        guard currentLock == .idle else {
   459	            throw KernelClientError.rpcRejected(
   460	                code: "session_locked",
   461	                message: "send() rejected: session \(session.sessionID) lock state is \(currentLock), expected idle (D1 v3.1 §9.3)"
   462	            )
   463	        }
   464	        lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] = .sendPending
   465	        defer {
   466	            // send_pending 只是"等待 kernel ack"的极短窗口——ack 到达（无论成功失败）后立刻释放。
   467	            if lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] == .sendPending {
   468	                lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] = .idle
   469	            }
   470	        }
   471	
   472	        var params: JSONObject = [
   473	            "key": kernelKey,
   474	            "message": resolveSendMessageText(from: input),
   475	            "timeoutMs": 0,
   476	        ]
   477	        // F2 rework：openclaw `gateway/server-methods/attachment-normalize.ts:29-56`
   478	        // （`normalizeRpcAttachmentsToChatAttachments`）只保留带 `content` 字段（base64 或字符串）
   479	        // 的附件，`.filter((a) => a.content)` 会把上一轮发送的 `{mimeType,path}` 形状直接丢弃（无
   480	        // content 字段）——见 `server-methods.test.ts:2693-2699` 明确验证这一点。本轮改为读取
   481	        // `Part.path` 指向的本地文件、base64 编码后塞进 `content`；读不到文件就诚实跳过这一个
   482	        // attachment（不编造 content，也不让整个 send() 失败——可能只是这一个 part 路径失效）。
   483	        if input.kind == .structured, let parts = input.parts {
   484	            // encodeAttachmentForWire 是 OpenclawWire.swift 里的纯函数（F2），不依赖 actor 状态，
   485	            // 方便 FrameReplayTests.swift 直接单测。
   486	            let attachments: [JSONObject] = parts.compactMap { part -> JSONObject? in
   487	                guard part.kind != .text else { return nil }
   488	                return encodeAttachmentForWire(part)
   489	            }
   490	            if !attachments.isEmpty {
   491	                params["attachments"] = attachments
   492	            }
   493	        }
   494	
   495	        let result = try await request(method: "sessions.send", params: params)
   496	        prettyPrint("RECV sessions.send result", result)
   497	
   498	        guard let runID = result["runId"] as? String else {
   499	            throw KernelClientError.protocolMismatch("sessions.send result missing 'runId' field")
   500	        }
   501	        lastRunIDBySessionID[session.sessionID] = runID
   502	        runIDsBySessionID[session.sessionID, default: []].insert(runID)
   503	        return SendResultPayload(runID: runID)
   504	    }
   505	
   506	    /// D1 Input -> openclaw `sessions.send.message`（纯文本字符串）的最小转换。`kind:.text` 直接用
   507	    /// `input.text`；`kind:.structured` 把 `parts` 里 `kind:.text` 的段落用换行拼接（非文本 part
   508	    /// 走上面 attachments 分支，不混进正文），三者都拿不到文本时退化为空字符串而不是抛错——openclaw
   509	    /// 的 `SessionsSendParamsSchema.message` 是必填 `Type.String()`，允许空串，比在这里主观拒绝更
   510	    /// 贴近"如实转发调用方输入"的适配器职责。
   511	    private func resolveSendMessageText(from input: Input) -> String {
   512	        if input.kind == .text {
   513	            return input.text ?? ""
   514	        }
   515	        let texts = (input.parts ?? []).compactMap { part -> String? in
   516	            guard part.kind == .text else { return nil }
   517	            return part.text
   518	        }
   519	        return texts.joined(separator: "\n")
   520	    }

   522	    /// D1 §2.3 subscribe。
   523	    ///
   524	    /// **rounds/0012 ② 二次返工（推翻上一版"subscribe() 自己等 ack"的修法）**：上一版把这个方法改成
   525	    /// 内联 `await` `sessions.messages.subscribe` RPC、等它真正落地（或失败）才 `return stream`——
   526	    /// 这个方向被证明是错的，两条独立理由：

   531	    ///    "拿到一个事件流"变成了"拿到一个已确认的事件流"，行为语义变了。

   535	    ///    "真实 subscribe() 同步（在第一次 await 之前）就把 eventContinuations[sessionID] 建好、

    44	async function createAgentMainSessionForSend(params: {
    45	  req: GatewayRequestHandlerOptions["req"];
    46	  canonicalKey: string;
    47	  context: GatewayRequestContext;
    48	  client: GatewayClient | null;
    49	  isWebchatConnect: GatewayRequestHandlerOptions["isWebchatConnect"];
    50	}): Promise<
    51	  | {
    52	      ok: true;
    53	      entry: SessionEntry;
    54	      canonicalKey: string;
    55	      storePath: string;
    56	    }
    57	  | { ok: false; error: ReturnType<typeof errorShape> }
    58	> {
    59	  const agentId = parseAgentSessionKey(params.canonicalKey)?.agentId;
    60	  if (!agentId) {
    61	    return {
    62	      ok: false,
    63	      error: errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, `session not found: ${params.canonicalKey}`),
    64	    };
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  let createResult:
    68	    | { ok: boolean; payload?: { key?: string }; error?: ReturnType<typeof errorShape> }
    69	    | undefined;
    70	  await expectDefined(
    71	    sessionCreateHandlers["sessions.create"],
    72	    "sessions.create handler",
    73	  )({
    74	    req: params.req,
    75	    params: {
    76	      key: params.canonicalKey,
    77	      agentId,
    78	    },
    79	    respond: (ok, payload, error) => {
    80	      createResult = {
    81	        ok,
    82	        payload: payload && typeof payload === "object" ? (payload as { key?: string }) : undefined,
    83	        error,
    84	      };
    85	    },
    86	    context: params.context,
    87	    client: params.client,
    88	    isWebchatConnect: params.isWebchatConnect,
    89	  });
    90	
    91	  if (!createResult) {
    92	    return {
    93	      ok: false,
    94	      error: errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "sessions.create did not respond"),
    95	    };
    96	  }
    97	  if (!createResult.ok) {
    98	    return {
    99	      ok: false,
   100	      error: createResult.error ?? errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "failed to create session"),
   101	    };
   102	  }
   103	
   104	  const createdKey = normalizeOptionalString(createResult.payload?.key) ?? params.canonicalKey;
   105	  const loaded = loadSessionEntryReadOnly(createdKey);
   106	  if (!loaded.entry?.sessionId) {
   107	    return {
   108	      ok: false,
   109	      error: errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, `session not created: ${createdKey}`),
   110	    };
   111	  }
   112	  return {
   113	    ok: true,
   114	    entry: loaded.entry,
   115	    canonicalKey: loaded.canonicalKey,
   116	    storePath: loaded.storePath,
   117	  };
   118	}

   120	export async function interruptSessionRunIfActive(params: {
   121	  req: GatewayRequestHandlerOptions["req"];
   122	  context: GatewayRequestContext;
   123	  client: GatewayClient | null;
   124	  isWebchatConnect: GatewayRequestHandlerOptions["isWebchatConnect"];
   125	  requestedKey: string;
   126	  canonicalKey: string;
   127	  agentId?: string;
   128	  sessionId?: string;
   129	}): Promise<{ interrupted: boolean; error?: ReturnType<typeof errorShape> }> {
   130	  const cfg = params.context.getRuntimeConfig();
   131	  const hasTrackedRun = hasTrackedActiveSessionRun({
   132	    context: params.context,
   133	    requestedKey: params.requestedKey,
   134	    canonicalKey: params.canonicalKey,
   135	    agentId: params.agentId,
   136	    defaultAgentId: resolveDefaultAgentId(cfg),
   137	  });
   138	  const hasEmbeddedRun =
   139	    typeof params.sessionId === "string" && params.sessionId
   140	      ? isEmbeddedAgentRunActive(params.sessionId)
   141	      : false;
   142	  const hasWorkerRun =
   143	    typeof params.sessionId === "string" && params.sessionId
   144	      ? (asWorkerInferenceControl(params.context.workerEnvironmentService)?.hasInferenceForSession(
   145	          params.sessionId,
   146	        ) ?? false)
   147	      : false;
   148	
   149	  if (!hasTrackedRun && !hasEmbeddedRun && !hasWorkerRun) {
   150	    return { interrupted: false };
   151	  }
   152	
   153	  if (hasTrackedRun || hasWorkerRun) {
   154	    let abortOk = true;
   155	    let abortError: ReturnType<typeof errorShape> | undefined;
   156	    const abortSessionKey = resolveAbortSessionKey({
   157	      context: params.context,
   158	      requestedKey: params.requestedKey,
   159	      canonicalKey: params.canonicalKey,
   160	    });
   161	
   162	    await expectDefined(
   163	      chatHandlers["chat.abort"],
   164	      "chat.abort handler",
   165	    )({
   166	      req: params.req,
   167	      params: {
   168	        sessionKey: abortSessionKey,
   169	        ...(params.canonicalKey === "global" && params.agentId ? { agentId: params.agentId } : {}),
   170	      },
   171	      respond: (ok, _payload, error) => {
   172	        abortOk = ok;
   173	        abortError = error;
   174	      },
   175	      context: params.context,
   176	      client: params.client,
   177	      isWebchatConnect: params.isWebchatConnect,
   178	    });
   179	
   180	    if (!abortOk) {
   181	      return {
   182	        interrupted: true,
   183	        error:
   184	          abortError ?? errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "failed to interrupt active session"),
   185	      };
   186	    }
   187	  }
   188	
   189	  if (hasEmbeddedRun && params.sessionId) {
   190	    abortEmbeddedAgentRun(params.sessionId);
   191	  }
   192	
   193	  // Clear queued follow-up work for both requested aliases and the canonical session id.
   194	  clearSessionQueues([params.requestedKey, params.canonicalKey, params.sessionId]);
   195	
   196	  if (hasEmbeddedRun && params.sessionId) {
   197	    const ended = await waitForEmbeddedAgentRunEnd(params.sessionId, 15_000);
   198	    if (!ended) {
   199	      return {
   200	        interrupted: true,
   201	        error: errorShape(
   202	          ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE,
   203	          `Session ${params.requestedKey} is still active; try again in a moment.`,
   204	        ),
   205	      };
   206	    }
   207	  }
   208	
   209	  return { interrupted: true };
   210	}

   248	    acpMetadataSessionKey: legacyKey ?? canonicalKey,

   256	        `Agent "${deletedAgentId}" no longer exists in configuration`,

   116	export function validateChatSelectedAgent(params: {
   117	  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
   118	  requestedSessionKey: string;
   119	  agentId?: string;
   120	}): { ok: true; agentId?: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
   121	  const agentId = params.agentId ? normalizeAgentId(params.agentId) : undefined;
   122	  if (!agentId) {
   123	    return { ok: true };
   124	  }
   125	  if (!listAgentIds(params.cfg).includes(agentId)) {
   126	    return { ok: false, error: `Unknown agent id "${params.agentId}"` };
   127	  }
   128	  const requestedSessionKey = params.requestedSessionKey.trim();
   129	  const parsed = parseAgentSessionKey(requestedSessionKey);
   130	  if (parsed && normalizeAgentId(parsed.agentId) !== agentId) {
   131	    return {
   132	      ok: false,
   133	      error: `agentId "${params.agentId}" does not match session key "${params.requestedSessionKey}"`,
   134	    };
   135	  }
   136	  if (requestedSessionKey.toLowerCase() === "global") {
   137	    return { ok: true, agentId };
   138	  }
   139	  if (resolveSessionStoreKey({ cfg: params.cfg, sessionKey: requestedSessionKey }) === "global") {
   140	    return { ok: true, agentId };
   141	  }
   142	  if (!parsed || normalizeAgentId(parsed.agentId) !== agentId) {
   143	    return {
   144	      ok: false,
   145	      error: `agentId "${params.agentId}" does not match session key "${params.requestedSessionKey}"`,
   146	    };
   147	  }
   148	  return { ok: true, agentId };
   149	}

   152	  cfg?: OpenClawConfig;
   153	  requestedSessionKey: string;
   154	  agentId?: string;

   156	  const explicitAgentId = normalizeOptionalText(params.agentId);

   167	  ) {
   168	    return undefined;

   298	export function explicitOriginTargetsAcpSession(
   299	  origin: ChatSendExplicitOrigin | undefined,
   300	): boolean {
   301	  if (!origin?.originatingChannel || !origin.originatingTo || !origin.accountId) {
   302	    return false;
   303	  }

   305	  if (!channel || channel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {

   309	    channel,
   310	    accountId: origin.accountId,
   311	    conversationId: origin.originatingTo,
   312	  });
   313	  return isAcpSessionKey(binding?.targetSessionKey);
   314	}

   334	export function normalizeOptionalChatSystemReceipt(
   335	  value: unknown,
   336	): { ok: true; receipt?: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
   337	  if (value == null) {
   338	    return { ok: true };
   339	  }
   340	  if (typeof value !== "string") {
   341	    return { ok: false, error: "systemProvenanceReceipt must be a string" };
   342	  }
   343	  const sanitized = sanitizeChatSendMessageInput(value);
   344	  if (!sanitized.ok) {
   345	    return sanitized;
   346	  }
   347	  const receipt = sanitized.message.trim();
   348	  return { ok: true, receipt: receipt || undefined };
   349	}

    91	export function createChatSendReplyDispatch(params: {
    92	  accountId: string | undefined;
    93	  isAgentRunStarted: () => boolean;
    94	  logGateway: GatewayRequestContext["logGateway"];
    95	  session: Pick<
    96	    PreparedChatSendSession,
    97	    "agentId" | "backingSessionId" | "cfg" | "clientRunId" | "sessionKey" | "sessionLoadOptions"
    98	  >;
    99	  userTurnRecorder: Pick<UserTurnTranscriptRecorder, "markBlocked">;
   100	}) {
   101	  const { accountId, isAgentRunStarted, logGateway, session, userTurnRecorder } = params;
   102	  const { agentId, backingSessionId, cfg, clientRunId, sessionKey, sessionLoadOptions } = session;
   103	  const { onModelSelected, ...replyPipeline } = createChannelMessageReplyPipeline({
   104	    cfg,
   105	    agentId,
   106	    channel: INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL,
   107	  });
   108	  const deliveredReplies: DeliveredChatSendReply[] = [];
   109	  let appendedWebchatAgentMedia = false;
   110	  const appendWebchatAgentMediaTranscriptIfNeeded = async (payload: ReplyPayload) => {
   111	    if (!isAgentRunStarted() || appendedWebchatAgentMedia || !isMediaBearingPayload(payload)) {
   112	      return;
   113	    }
   114	    if (isSourceReplyTranscriptMirrorPayload(payload)) {
   115	      return;
   116	    }
   117	    const ttsSupplementMarker = buildTtsSupplementTranscriptMarker(payload);
   118	    const [transcriptPayload] = await normalizeWebchatReplyMediaPathsForDisplay({
   119	      cfg,
   120	      sessionKey,
   121	      agentId,
   122	      accountId,
   123	      payloads: [stripVisibleTextFromTtsSupplement(payload)],
   124	    });
   125	    if (!transcriptPayload) {
   126	      return;
   127	    }
   128	    const { storePath: latestStorePath, entry: latestEntry } = loadSessionEntry(
   129	      sessionKey,
   130	      sessionLoadOptions,
   180	      agentId,
   181	      createIfMissing: true,
   182	      idempotencyKey: `${clientRunId}:assistant-media`,
   183	      ttsSupplement: ttsSupplementMarker,
   184	      cfg,
   185	    });
   186	    if (appended.ok) {
   187	      if (appended.messageId && assistantContent?.length) {
   188	        await attachManagedOutgoingImagesToMessage({
   189	          messageId: appended.messageId,
   190	          blocks: assistantContent,
   191	        });
   192	      }
   193	      appendedWebchatAgentMedia = true;
   194	      return;
   195	    }
   196	    logGateway.warn(
   197	      `webchat transcript append failed for media reply: ${appended.error ?? "unknown error"}`,
   198	    );
   199	  };

   201	    ...replyPipeline,

   203	      logGateway.warn(`webchat dispatch failed: ${formatForLog(err)}`);
   204	    },
   205	    deliver: async (payload, info) => {

   207	      if (
   208	        payloadMetadata?.beforeAgentRunBlocked === true ||
   209	        payloadMetadata?.sourceReplyTranscriptMirror?.transcriptWriteBlocked === true
   210	      ) {
   211	        userTurnRecorder.markBlocked();
   212	      }
   213	      switch (info.kind) {
   214	        case "block":
   215	        case "final":
   216	          deliveredReplies.push({ payload, kind: info.kind });
   217	          await appendWebchatAgentMediaTranscriptIfNeeded(payload);
   218	          break;
   219	        case "tool":
   220	          // TTS tool media becomes a final payload so downstream audio extraction sees it.
   221	          if (isMediaBearingPayload(payload)) {
   222	            deliveredReplies.push({
   223	              payload: { ...payload, text: undefined },
   224	              kind: "final",
   225	            });

   227	          break;
   228	      }
   229	    },
   230	  });
   231	  return {

    16	export type ExecApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState =
    17	  | { kind: "enabled"; channel: string | undefined; channelLabel: string; accountId?: string }

    23	function labelForChannel(channel?: string): string {
    24	  if (channel === "tui") {
    25	    return "terminal UI";
    26	  }
    27	  if (channel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL) {
    28	    return "Web UI";
    29	  }
    30	  return (

    33	  );

    36	function hasNativeExecApprovalCapability(channel?: string): boolean {
    37	  const capability = resolveChannelApprovalCapability(getChannelPlugin(channel ?? ""));
    38	  if (!capability?.native) {
    39	    return false;
    40	  }

    42	}

    44	/** Resolves whether exec approvals can be handled on the initiating surface. */
    45	export function resolveExecApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState(params: {
    46	  channel?: string | null;
    47	  accountId?: string | null;
    48	  cfg?: OpenClawConfig;
    49	}): ExecApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState {
    50	  return resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState({ ...params, approvalKind: "exec" });

    52	
    53	/** Resolves whether approvals of a given kind can be handled on the initiating surface. */
    54	export function resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState(params: {
    55	  channel?: string | null;
    56	  accountId?: string | null;
    57	  cfg?: OpenClawConfig;
    58	  approvalKind: ApprovalKind;
    59	}): ExecApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState {
    60	  const channel = normalizeMessageChannel(params.channel);
    61	  const channelLabel = labelForChannel(channel);
    62	  const accountId = normalizeOptionalString(params.accountId);
    63	  if (!channel || channel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL || channel === "tui") {
    64	    return { kind: "enabled", channel, channelLabel, accountId };
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  const cfg = params.cfg ?? getRuntimeConfig();
    68	  const capability = resolveChannelApprovalCapability(getChannelPlugin(channel));
    69	  // Prefer the exec-specific hook, then the generic approval hook, before
    70	  // falling back to basic deliverability for channels without native state.
    71	  const state =
    72	    (params.approvalKind === "exec"
    73	      ? capability?.getExecInitiatingSurfaceState?.({
    74	          cfg,
    75	          accountId: params.accountId,
    76	          action: "approve",
    77	        })
    78	      : undefined) ??
    79	    capability?.getActionAvailabilityState?.({
    80	      cfg,
    81	      accountId: params.accountId,
    82	      action: "approve",
    83	      approvalKind: params.approvalKind,
    84	    });
    85	  if (state) {
    86	    return { ...state, channel, channelLabel, accountId };
    87	  }
    88	  if (isDeliverableMessageChannel(channel)) {
    89	    return { kind: "enabled", channel, channelLabel, accountId };
    90	  }
    91	  return { kind: "unsupported", channel, channelLabel, accountId };
    92	}

    99	  }

     1	// Checks whether an approval reply can route to the initiating turn source.
     2	import { getRuntimeConfig } from "../config/config.js";
     3	import { INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL, normalizeMessageChannel } from "../utils/message-channel.js";
     4	import { resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState } from "./exec-approval-surface.js";

     6	/** Returns whether approval replies can route back to the turn's initiating surface. */
     7	export function hasApprovalTurnSourceRoute(params: {
     8	  turnSourceChannel?: string | null;
     9	  turnSourceAccountId?: string | null;
    10	  approvalKind?: "exec" | "plugin";
    11	}): boolean {
    12	  const channel = normalizeMessageChannel(params.turnSourceChannel);
    13	  // INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL is webchat; web and TUI routes exist only while
    14	  // their approval-capable Gateway clients are connected and counted separately.
    15	  if (!channel || channel === INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL || channel === "tui") {
    16	    return false;
    17	  }
    18	  return (
    19	    resolveApprovalInitiatingSurfaceState({
    20	      channel,
    21	      accountId: params.turnSourceAccountId,
    22	      cfg: getRuntimeConfig(),
    23	      approvalKind: params.approvalKind ?? "exec",
    24	    }).kind === "enabled"
    25	  );
    26	}
   285	  if (!isApprovalDecision(rawParams.decision)) {
   286	    params.respond(false, undefined, errorShape(ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, "invalid decision"));
   287	    return null;
   288	  }
   289	  return {
   290	    inputId: rawParams.id,
   291	    decision: rawParams.decision,
   292	  };
   293	}
